Terrible rude staff especially with special assistance I travel with my disabled son and when we arrived at at the desk for check in the woman who served us was so rude My son isnt an ambulatory wheelchair user but he walks slowly and we would be happy to get help to the gate She said if he needs special assistance he needs to sit in a wheelchair otherwise she is going to cancel it I tried to explain to her that he is fine without a wheelchair but she kept repeating herself not accepting any other answer My son started to get very anxious and nervous because he thought he needs to be taken to hospital by using wheelchair and finally she said if he doesnt want using wheelchair chair he isnt disabled person Does she have the medical education to comment on this  I tried to stay calm because my son was stressful enough so I didnt want make him more feeling stressed anyway she cancelled special assistance for him The airport staff having this job only because so many tourists coming to visit Fuerteventura so they should respect that instead of being horrible and making people feel like an unwanted intruder on their wonderful island Nowhere else have we been treated so horribly like at this airport

Awful For an island that relies totally on tourism the time taken to get through passport control was just not good enough Everybody should be prepared to accept queues but when you are in a queue of hundreds and there is one person in the passport control kiosks it simply isnt good enough Is it to punish the Brits for Brexit Cant think what other reason it could be for as it certainly doesnt put you in a good light Big improvement required

Never have I experienced such a hot extremely slow journey through customs This is unacceptable only one person checking passports with long queues and no air conditioning People very tired and hot and babies crying Absolute disgrace and has put me off returning

I am a non ambulatory wheelchair user accompanied by my husband After prompt check in I was obliged to wait at least  minutes with other disabled before being guided to another place in departures I was told that I would be contacted at this point at least half an hour before departure We went immediately to a refreshment area to buy a much needed coffee but were sought out by an attendant who told us that we need to be at the departure gate I told the attendant that I must first use the disabled toilet and was pressured by him that I needed to be quick What a joke I have never been in such a badly equipped disabled toilet and discovered to my horror that there were no fixed grab rails to help me stand to pull myself together Only one wobbly drop rail I opened the toilet door knowing that I could pull myself up using the door frame Fortunately a lovely attendant was there and realising my dilemma she helped me to pull myself together I have never been so mortified in my life but she was very sweet The impatient attendant was waiting for me in the public area On the verge of tears my husband calmed me as we followed the attendant to the departure gate where we waited for another  minutes It the door of the airplane I was transferred to a small loading chair and was dragged on board amongst the confusion with other walking passengers We have used this airport more than  and always rated it fairly but now a recently disabled amputee I am disgusted with the whole departure experience

Absolutely terrible customer service Got frisked twice and kept having to go to the back and queue again for the privilege All my of things removed so fast still on the tray to another place I didnt know whether I was coming or going My belongings were gone and I couldnt find them Luckily I asked a man where they could be and they had been taken to lost and found My car keys phone purse tablet and Apple Watch Much to my horror I was spoken to like a fool and he demanded evidence that they were my belongings I managed to convince him to let me have my phone so I could prove they were mine

I am disabled and had just been given a cancer diagnosis by my doctor on the phone whilst in Fuerteventura I had one of the last two flights that night and had been ill all week I had mentioned this to the team and said I was very weak as a result and needed a bit of extra help My flight was due to depart at  and by  I found myself in the special assistance area with one other couple who were on the other plane leaving at the same time  members of the special assistance team came over and I asked if someone was there for me I was told to calm down and that I had to wait my turn I had asked in a low voice and was perfectly calmly I waited another  mins and when I looked there were  other people in the airport cleaners  mins until my flight left and no staff or any way of contacting them Getting distressed and being in pain the cleaner helped me by going to find someone Last call for my flight had been announced twice already When the  members of staff arrived they were so rude to me I couldnt believe it I asked why I had been left and they just laughed at me it got heated and she stopped pushing me and said Do you want to walk  I mean really Thats what you threaten disabled customers with when they are unhappy with service  I tried to get out of the chair  as by now I was so upset and felt so belittled by these  women but she pushed the chair so I couldnt catching my foot and dragging it

Very pleasantly surprised by this airport  especially after our home airport of East Midlands Arrived to find airbridges to the aircraft so no busses or walking across the tarmac baggage didnt take long and easily found a taxi for the short journey to our hotel When we departed we checked the bags into a check in area with no one queueing we were a bit but only a bit early and had a drink outside before going through security This was a bit confusing  got turned away from one security queue as it was for families  could have been a bit better sign posted The actual proper security was just behind the check in desks  again this could have been made a little more obvious But once through the actual departure area was vast spacious and light with  outside areas at least  childrens play areas lots of different eating choices and quite a few duty free options Didnt try any eating places so cant comment on prices Plenty of places to sit and wandering down to the end of the hall there were some deserted and very quiet parts All in all very pleasant and far better than most in holiday destinations

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

Never have I been to an airport with staff so keen to help and so lovely After a baggage mishap at Shanghai Airport I arrived at Fukoaka knowing that my bag was not on the flight that I was on Upon arrival immigration was a breeze even with a British passport and I went straight to the arrivals desk where four people immediately helped me They were so kind and helpful and sorted out my problem immediately They reassured me that everything would be ok and even gave me a  yen note to pay for the delivery of my luggage to where I was staying somewhere around  hours away from Fukoaka The whole airport experience was wonderful in comparison to the rude service I received at Shanghai Pu Dong Airport Thank you to everyone who helped out a traveler who had lost his baggage

Upon arrival moved swiftly thru immigration The luggages for all the passengers did not arrive  some malfuntion was announced  it took  minutes for the luggage to finally arrive No announcement during that time There are no seats in the areas so every one sat in th floor waiting Upon departure also check in and immigration moved very fast Went to the Fukuoka lounge  very spacious but very limited food Soup Noodles and bread

Compared to NRT  HND  KIX this airport is left lacking It is small so should have been an easy one to transfer in but with very little time one had to get out of the domestic terminal and wait for a bus ride to take you to the international terminal After some  minutes ride you get there and it was quite difficult to figure out where to go Finally getting to departures you had to queue for a long time for both security scanning and passport control The staff were very rude unlike elsewhere in Japan where one always gets a great welcome They tried to pull the basket away before I had even put everything in it No hello After enduring the rudeness you had the very slow passport check queue which took forever Left no time for shopping or enjoying the terminal Grabbing a few items in panic I got to the gate There was still just the call to go to the gate but for some reason I heard my name called on the tannoy I presented myself The gate staff offered no explanation nor smiles looking at my boarding pass and then handing it back to me It was most odd The up shot is if you are using FUK make sure you have a lot of time and dont expect the usual Japanese manners Certainly made this traveler feel most unwelcome

Arrived in FUK on Nov  and departed Nov  fromto Shanghai Arrival was a breeze Baggage reclaim immigration and custom clearance were fast and smooth Staff efficient and smiling Departure was terrible Only  Xray machine for all check in bags from  flights of pax resulting in long lines looping around the entire check in island Waited  mins before bags scanned and allowed to check in Then carry on bags had to subject to another check with long lines again Another  mins wasted standing in queue This was clearly quite unsatisfactory and a pity as the airport was otherwise very clean modern great looking with helpful and friendly staff

Google flights told me that our flight was delayed by  hours before I arrived at the airport On arrival we checked with airport staff and they confirmed the flight status was fine The signs sent us to our boarding gate which meant going through passport control On arrival at the gate they have not opened it and so nobody is able to sit down After waiting  minutes there is an announcement that our flight is delayed by  hour and  minutes just under the  hour mark which would entitle us to food and drinks Google flights still says that our  flight to Stansted will not be leaving until  The gate has still not been opened Very few passengers can sit down Elderly passengers are standing up in a queue for an unknown amount of time None of us are able to get back up to the airport where we could by food and drinks The airport signs still do not show that the flight is delayed therefore passengers will still be being sent down here without warning that they will be trapped Very deceitful behaviour from Funchal airport and Jet

Nice airport pleasant staff and security excellent Poor check in resources for a BA flight to Heathrow took ages for them to set up I think due to lack of staff Lead lady did the work of  people Lounge nice but on the basic side but I expected this One staff member officious Then the horror of having to wait after the gate was called before they would open passport control which was a dour experience Then a wait to be allowed in the gate Same overworked lady managing on her own

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight  departure date which eventually took off  All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

I could not buy any gluten free food at the airport I ended up with a big bag of crisps Sem Gluten the previous shop told me none of the crisps where GF and she sold the same ones I bought It was an experience I will not be repeating the last time I visit Madeira It is disgraceful that a person is left hungry by greedy cafe owners

Worst airport experience Transavia flight TO from Funchal to Porto was cancelled due to bad weather conditions Since arrival time at airport at am I spent  hours at the airport for transfer to hotel to be organized Hundreds of passengers waited like cattle to be processed Airports announcements unintelligible No minimum distance kept In times of a pandemic utterly unacceptable to be forced to queue for hours and risk health with hundreds of other passengers Unprofessional and unfriendly personnel No information and transparency whatsoever provided I was informed by email that my flight was cancelled It never was shown on screen or announced I strongly advise flying to Funchal airport  in case of unforeseen conditions be prepared to endure harsh conditions Madeira never again Side note at arrival to Madeira very painful testing experience

Their covid testing team do a terrible job I felt my brain tickled and stabbed It is sharp its stabbing  I cant even really describe the feeling Ended up with an intense taste of blood in my throat My legs of their own accord not controlled by my brain shoot up and start kicking as if Im flailing as if Im in the electric chair If its done correctly it shouldnt be excruciatingly painful as it is in my case on both times I arrived in this airport this summer I would prefer to be punched in the nose while leaving the aircraft than going through this again Both my mother and father felt the same My question is who are the people doing these tests Be careful

Going through security screening was a nightmare I was told I was an explosive threat after having my hands screened twice and producing a positive result twice They said this can happen to people who have used certain body lotionscreams medications touched certain items ie flowers I was then escorted very indiscreetly by  armed police officers to a separate room where I was searched my hand luggage searched and I was questioned After all this I had to go through the whole process again security hands screened positive result by which time I was very distressed A terrifying experience for a  year old woman  I do understand the need to keep air passengers safe but this screening technology is clearly not efficient or sufficient if it can be triggered by ingredients in creams and lotions I will never return to Madeira

TSA Combination locks changed by baggage handlers at Madeira airport My cabin cases were put in the hold by easyJet at Bristol Airport I handed the two cases to easyJet staff just before going up the steps when boarding as they were concerned there was not enough overhead locker space No problem Ive done this many times before When picking up the hire car at Funchal airport I needed to access the cabin cases only to find my combination lock numbers had been changed The hire car reps managed to open the one case but the lock on the other had to be broken open Apparently this is not unusual at Funchal this was the fifth time they had experienced it These mindless pranksters should be sacked A great start to the holiday Has anyone else experienced this problem

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

I had a terrible experience at Gdask airport today at the executive lounge I arrived too early for my flight and decided to avail of its service There is a machine in the departures hall where you can buy a ticket which I used It was a very straightforward transaction The price of Zl  came up I inserted my credit card and got a ticket On arriving to the executive lounge I was told that I could only use it no earlier than  hours prior to my departure The staff member wouldnt call a supervisor wouldnt let me use the service now instead of later wouldnt refund the cost and actually told me to leave She was extremely unhelpful ignorant and confrontational She actually enjoyed the situation and her power over it She kept telling me about the rules but nowhere on the machine in the process of buying the ticket did I see any notice about a  hours timeframe The ticket itself didnt specify it either I respect the rules but they should be clear visible and transparent So two major problems confusing and well hidden rules and terrible staff in the executive lounge

The Internet connection is timed to  minutes and so bad mobile is far superior theres not enough seats and those that are there are extremely uncomfortable hard plastic with dividers No quiet zones low temperature makes you catch cold and then theres the staff The service is forced and makes you feel bad for even ordering anything and dont try resting at any of the restaurants better chairs  theyll call security even in the middle of the night Reason Well who really knows maybe they like seeing people resting on the cold floors since theres not enough seats  Theres even a dedicated announcement just to remind there are thieves If you can avoid especially if you have to lay over  pay a bit more and choose one you know to be peoplefriendly

I am partially disabled with restricted mobility I have metal in my leg and hip following reconstructive surgery As a frequent traveller I know I set off the security metal archway detector therefore I know what to expect and ensure I carry no additional material which might exasperate my situation Noting some airports adjust the sensitivity of these detectors So back to the Gdask experience Having detected the archway I am directed to remove my footwear My trainers are clothplastic no metal This is the default situation and very annoying It is obviously not my shoes that cause the alarm Of course there are no aids by example a chair and I am forced to comply or no fly So no shoes but despite my explanations I again alert the archway I did tell you that would happen  me to the suspicious security person  now a physical search Remember I am partially disabled Stand on one leg and show me your sole Im  years of age and there is no standing support aid I am then very roughly treated by a security thug who has the compassion and intellect of a slug Frankly this was probably my worst experience over the years Shame on you Polish Civil Aviation Authority Treat partially disabled travelers with restricted movement with more respect and compassion

Airport Security very bad was a big queue take as more than  hour to pass through no speaking English shouting and screaming all the time with out no reason They dont let us priorities to catch our flight and we miss our flights Straight away they remove us from airport with out any help during to rescheduled our flight down stairs

Health and safety rules are very loosely followed I was marked for a random check the one where they check your hands for traces of explosives The female security worker was not wearing her mask and I asked her to put it on before approaching me Since then she was plain rude to me and barked orders The two hand sanitizers that I could locate were empty When I looked around practically none of the staff were wearing their masks correctly even though it was crowded

Access to the airport from the underground station is easy to find and well signposted Due to the high volume of passengers the waiting times for the checkin and security check were long There is a good selection of shops and restaurants The toilets are too few and quite old

I arrived on Sunday nd February to go skiing for a week and from entering the terminal building after getting off the plane to getting through passport control took over two hours A complete and utter shambolic airport On the way back on the th from being dropped off outside the airport it again took two hours to get to the departure lounge complete chaos and no one cares All they want is the money from us for using their airport My best advice to anybody is to avoid the airport at all costs so you do not get really disappointed and frustrated that I did

Terminal  is an absolute joke it is akin to a bus shelter The airport is losing so much money by making passengers wait for bus transfers to the main Terminal and by the time they arrive at Terminal  there is no time to eat drink or spend any money in the shops You provide  transfer bus every mins whilst you are checking in  flights at a time This is the worst airport that I have ever travelled from and I have travelled the world Third world countries can do a lot better than this Very disappointing

Absolute chaos departing from Geneva yesterday Monday  February  It took just over an hour to get our passports stamped which was about the same time as the flight to LHR The queues were enormous as there were far too few staff available The number of positions open varied from three to five with staff just closing up and walking off It wasnt much better for Swiss and EU passengers Probably not their fault as they would be instructed by management An appalling experience made worse by airport staff not putting our skis on the aircraft Overall a dreadful advert for Geneva and Switzerland

Third world system Absolutely awful The queue to get out of the airport is going to be longer than the flight Sweating because its so hot in the queue Screaming kids and babies because theyre hot and tired UK flags covered with white stickers to hide them just to spite us for leaving the EU really Dont be so petty You didnt have them covered when we first left No markers to tell you how long to expect No staff to make sure everyone is OK Lanes not properly marked so people in wrong queue and lots of queue jumping  just a shambles  shame on the Swiss I thought you were better than this Arrived in the terminal an hour ago and still no end in sight Apparently several UK flights land at the same time on Saturday night Transfer companies know it and expect it so its not a one off Fly to another airport if you can assuming theyre any better

Utterly inefficient organisation Checkin and organisation of security queues were totally chaotic with inefficiency everywhere On the evidence if this airport I have no idea where the myth of Swiss efficiency comes from Also extravagantly overpriced for everything and poor quality food and beverage Really unfriendly security staff

Far better experience at Geneva on departure Checkin queues were long but moved quickly enough No delays at Security or Immigration so got the gate  minutes early despite the long walk Reason being I assume because there were few other departures around that time Shopping area is cramped and crowded

Geneva really must get its act together Arrived at about  on Sunday Queues for immigration were one hour plus for non Eu and  minutes for eu passengers Admittedly three large intercontinental flights had recently arrived together but still unacceptable

We transitted via Geneva on our way home to Copenhagen after a holiday in Malta Ive flown into and out of Geneva a number of times albeit not for around thirty years The airport is poorly designed with long walks to and from the various satellites Its certainly showing its age and is in dire need of an update The most noticeable thing was that the majority of the staff seemed unhappy With the sole exception of a smiling women at Security all of the staff wore a scowl and ony helped begrudgingly Unless its your home or destination Id suggest avoiding Geneva Airport

Everything looked well as we arrived from Palermo en route to Manchester as our bags arrived within  minutes and checked in within  minutes Thats where it started to unravel The security was inept with  people checking  flights It took  minutes to get through passport control despite Ryanair calling  times to get us all boarded Even when the security guy was told the Manchester flight had priority over the Tirana flight which was an hour behind ours We just got on board with minutes to spare More staff needed and better communication rather than a s PA system Avoid Genoa airport if you can

This airport is small but convenient but also quite dated looking It looks like its stuck in the s and seating isnt comfortable Dutyfree is readily available and there are a few small kiosks serving food and beverages Security check is fast and efficient but also looks like how it was done  years ago There are different bus services to the city center

Flight to Amsterdam was canceled due to the weather conditions thats how it was and acceptable The handling at the airport was unacceptable all over The help desk appeared ignorant and arrogant to the affected customers The assisting crew only  at the counters were ignoring our need for help and it appeared as they picked people by names and not from the huge crowded  lines Compared to other airports around the world this incident yesterday October th was the worst I have ever been a part of and the airport should absolutely evaluate the lack of service provided to KLM and the customers involved Do hope for improvement in the future matters concerned

Arrival following amended flight from Paris see CDG report we went to the lost luggage desk to report our loss but the operative there said we would have to wait a half hour because his computer was down The fact that we were late for the departure our of our cruise liner did not seem to register Eventually after help from the marvelous cabin crew from our Air Dolomiti flight he shrugged his shoulders and told us just Go On return we went to the same office aided by the courteous customs and police where a very efficient lady located our missing paperwork and we were away Only to join a massive queue of passengers from the liner being security checked using just  of the  scanners who in any case missed the liquids which my wife had forgotten to remove from her hand baggage There were a lot of sweaty bodies flying out that day

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough
Its an absolute disgrace that all mens toilets and the disabled toilet at Gibraltar Departures have run out of toilet paper How can that happen Very unhappy

My  year old mother traveled alone to the UK on December   but unfortunately the flight was diverted to Malaga airport She has to have disabled assistance as she is unable to walk As per usual protocol all passengers were walked across the border in the pouring rain I might say and into a coach Spain side The issues with disabled assistance started once outside Malaga airport All passengers were left to remove their own baggage from the coach hold A reasonable ask if you are a fully abled person My mother and another disabled passenger were left behind to fend for themselves It was a kind and thoughtful passer by that removed the suitcases for them They then had to make their own way unaided to the desk By the time my mother reached the desk she could barely speak and nearly passed out This is appalling and these passengers should not have to find themselves in such circumstances when traveling This needs to be addressed by the disability team at Gibraltar Airport who are usually amazing I feel that perhaps they are totally unaware that this service which is requested at the point of paying for a flight totally and utterly breaks down when these flights are diverted Outside Malaga airport these passengers who are unable to walk unaided are left stranded and so I felt it is vitally important for Gibraltar Airport and the disabled services concerned to be made aware of it I have also emailed BA the airline concern

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant  whod had a similar injury  gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all

We used the new terminal for the first time this year The new airport departure lounge is spacious clean bright and airy At around the time of our departure there were several flights scheduled to depart and found that both of the toilets in the departure lounge were closed one for cleaning and the other due to a blockage I walked from one set of toilet to the other being sent to the others which were also closed with the staff not seeming to be aware that both sets of toilet were closed One of the toilets reopened after me complaining Maybe the airport management should ensure that at least one set of toilets are kept open especially during busy times when several departures are scheduled I was surprised that the new state of the art airport lacks air bridges to aircraft rather than still needing to walk out to the aircraft and climb steps to board

I visit Gibraltar airport regularly for trips backwards and forwards to the UK and to pick up friends and relatives who are visiting I am appalled by the condition of the glass screens on the viewing tower and stairs leading to the viewing tower the glass screens gave not been cleaned since the airport opened and are now at the stage where you cannot see through them Equally the stairs are dusty dirty and litter ridden

The airport is much improved since I was last here in  Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

As per usual security is minimally manned with very long queues They seem to be surprised by flights arriving and leaving When I complained that a second machine needed to be opened at security to process people quicker they all laughed and said they were waiting on a break I think the two crews that were obviously available were rotating around rather than sound security processing This shows a lack of leadership in an important part of the airport

Its a pretty bad airport The airport itself is not bad in terms of cleanliness or anything But the experience at this airport leaves a lot to be desired To begin with it is far too small and clearly does not have the capacity to handle a lot of traffic The lines to go through immigration are utterly ridiculous The line went literally from one end of the airport to the other And moved at snails pace People were missing their flights Second issue is the rude and just dont give an eff attitude of much of the staff there Nevermind that most cant even speak English Provided you can even find anyone to help you or that gives a damn about helping you This is really more like a provincial airport than an actual international airport I have had far better experience at airports in developing African countries in terms of service South Korea should be embarrassed by this joke of an airport I would give a minus rating for the airport staff if I could But sadly a single star will have to do

Quite busy airport in South Korea Arrival went relatively fast since i arrived from Mongolia you had to fill a health declaration form at the airport which you could do on an iPad or simply write a paper form Didnt take much time and also the queue to passport control wasnt very long Luggage was already at the belt after clearing all formalities Had a  hour layover in Busan so wanted to leave my luggage at the airport and upstairs they do have a left luggage office so that worked nicely Airport is connected to the metro network so moving around is easy On departure later in the evening it was quite busy it was difficult to find empty seat on airside All seats are cramped in the middle of the corridor surrounded by shops and restaurants you cannot really get by the window so not a good place for planespotting Terminal feels more like a train or bus station

Worst airport ever for welcoming foreigners Arrived in the morning and there was a queue of around  foreigners and one immigration officer Whilst the Korean passport holders breezed through There is a sign which reads Gimhae Airport How Korea Welcomes the World What a joke

Immigration queue was terrible Queue was so long for arrival and even longer for departure The airport should do something about this I have no complaints about the immigration officers it was just the queue that was unbelievable Could they please at least have dedicated lane for business class passengers or at least provide a fasttrack card

I cannot praise enough the airport assistance staff at Girona airport My son has autism and I was wearing the Sunflower Lanyard Assistance staff saw me waiting and came over to me to make themselves know and offer assistance at check in security and boarding the plane Fantastic staff

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then  minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff

front of the terminal PassportBorder control can be busy and crowded if more than one aircraft inespecially for UK passengers Luggage collection hall is large with six carousels but again can get very I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of  and a bit of  Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte  an  mile flight First  being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

Absolutely horrendous from start to finish Delays I can handle and are not the airports problem generally however the chaos on check in and baggage drop etc was unfathomable Tannoy announcements telling travellers to be at gate now when everyone is standing in a check in queue was not great neither oversized baggage needs a separate system not an aisle in the middle of all the check in aisles Horrendous experience however I feel that things will it change Cheese in duty free was good hence the  score

Hundreds of people shut outside the airport in the freezing cold not allowed to enter due to overcrowding Inside it is everyone for themselves  people everywhere chaos at check in desks Baggage belts not working staff scrambling over desks Out on the runway passengers walking all over the place no concerns for security or safety by staff Horrendous experience The time you might save by flying here compared to Geneva is not enough to warrant setting foot in this airport Dont do it

This airport is the most disorganised of any that I have flown from Some small investments in barriers to organise passengers at check in could make a massive difference There is a general lack of guidance by the supervisors to transit passengers through the airport Whilst the transfer to Geneva is an hour longer if you are going to experience close to a  minute delay I would say its a better investment of time Rather disappointing given the proximity to the ski resorts

I hate this airport with all my heart and am never coming here again If you are smart then never come to this airport because you will be highly disappointed in the incompetence of the ability of the airport Do the right thing and never come to this airport Never come to Grenoble

Astoundingly incompetently run airport  seriously too many passengers for this small airport to cope with  literally teetering on the edge of falling apart if one more thing goes wrong or a couple of staff go sick No info on booking in screens why not should be an easy fix so they have extra staff to try and organise this section  minute wait Long queues to Departure Lounge  people  where again they employ extra staff to pull out passengers in danger of missing their flight as they spend so much time queueing   hour wait Long queues to get through Xray security  minute wait  insufficient staffmachines all this leads to no time in the departure loungeduty free before you are again moved through to the gate  where you are packed in tight   and where there is yet another  minute delay

The worst airport ever I had to fly from Grenoble Airport because my flight from Lyon Airport was cancelled and this was the only option available going back to Gatwick at the same date due to French workers strike action I carried snow chains for my car because I drove in the French Alps at high above m where according to French government you have to have winter tires or snow chains for your car I carried my snow chains because the rental car company didnt provide winter tires and the snow chains for  days was  extra I took my own snow chains I had no problem taking them in my hand bag from Gatwick going through Lyon Airport arriving in France Neither UK border on departure nor British Airways had any problems with me carrying them in my hand luggage because they are only kg weight and fit into my back pack However upon departure from Grenoble very rude lady at security check confiscated the snow chains with the argument that she doesnt allow these on board also she stated that Grenoble airport doesnt allow snow chains too When I asked to show me proof where this was stated and I showed my previous tickets that I flew with them in my back pack she said if I dont sign the paper that they are confiscating the chains I will not fly she took my passport and my phone with my boarding pass When I asked for her batch number and name and her supervisor too so I can complain I was refused the information
The absolute worst airport in history So poorly run Any other airport I have travelled through is better by a huge margin Any of the other local airports are OK just avoid Grenoble

Queue from getting off plane through immigration without toilet facilities or refreshments took at least  hours This was longer than the flight time was very uncomfortable and nearly caused the cancellation of a v expensive transfer In short an appalling disgrace We will never fly through this airport again

This is the only airport that I have come across that does not allow bicycle helmets though security I got turned back from security because of my bicycle helmet a large crowd gathered to try and help me but the security people had a piece of paper saying no motorcycle helmets and had never seen a bicycle helmet before I am going to actively try and get this changed as checking my bicycle helmet is not an option for me This airport does not seem to take feedback This airport does not seem to want to improve their service
Not friendly or helpful at the front desk and unorganized They were not helpful when the Volaris airline cancelled our flight and pretty much told us to deal with it on our own

The staff at this airport are always in a bad mood to begin with When it comes to doing their job as informative employees they failed immensely I was ignored multiple times when asking where to find a fill out form The employees there treat people so badly My mother flew in from LAX  minutes after I did and was yelled at for not knowing what form to fill out on the way out It was her first time traveling and my sister had just passed Instead of being treated with kindness and helpfulness she was yelled at These employees are always rude unhelpful and honestly dont know how to do their job Please enforce a training for better customer service or hire people that know how to treat people with respect I would rate a  but unfortunately I cannot

They had us waiting in a huge line while our flight time dwindled away We got out of line at  pretty much missing the flight if we didnt sprint to the terminal Worst airport for sure and I travel a lot

Overall I find Guadalajara Airport to be quite user friendly with helpful staff a decent variety of restaurants cafes and shops Security lines are usually efficient and quick Terminals clean and plenty of seating space Several airline lounges and affordable ground transportation options to the city center and nearby areas One of the easiest Mexican airports to navigate

GDL  seems to have completed the main phase of its cosmetic renovations but still lacks some of the structural improvements to provide more spacious checkin counters space in the waiting lounge and more jet bridges Latest development witnessed many international flights still on the tarmac awaiting pax to arrive via caterpillarlike buses Simply unacceptable for Mexicos second largest city and third most enplaned airport in the country

Wonderful experience they saved me from missing my flight I was traveling with my family in China and this airport was my second transit trough this country My first encounter was with Chongqing airport which was significantly worse because my flight was unexpectedly cancelled and they just barely managed to book another one I still had a little time but I was worried if I could make it in time With just  minutes left I rushed to find my check in and when this amazing staff found out how little time I had they literally enscorted me and my family to my gate They were communicating with walkie talkies so we were being preferred throughout the way to catch our flight The most pleasant staff ever I will be forever thankful

Travellers beware There is not a lot to do at this airport Security staff are unpleasant as are the staff who inspect your boarding pass and check your passport Despite being on transit they check your boarding pass and then stamp it Security is a standard screen There are just a few shops and no place to buy water or drinks after immigration ie in the transit area There are two or three restaurants selling Chinese food where none of the staff speak English and communication is hard but they do try to help you There is one coffee place and a Starbucks far away near A gate Wifi is patchy and you have to register your passport on a machine before you can access wifi Thankfully they do have water dispensers around the airport If youre in transit here bring food and a good book and make sure you download movies on your device and be prepared to be bored
Worst service I have ever encountered in an airport talked to me like Im a criminal when I have done nothing wrong For an international airport in a supposedly tier  city totally unacceptable

If you are Chinese this airport is adequate Any other nationality forget it Ridiculous necessity to scan a health declaration form the majority of this form is in Chinese Also when entering a new country its unlikely people have internet on their phone to do so The few assistants available only speak Chinese A lot of the free WiFi stations do not work the ones that do work have very confusing instructions Will never fly through China again

Guangzhou Baiyun Airport is the most impressive airport for me The ground staff of China Southern Airlines are very warm and have a good attitude This aspect is much better than many domestic airports Since I booked the hotel next to the boarding gate I needed to get the ticket to pass the security check and customs one day in advance The staff of China Southern Airlines helped me to coordinate with the customs and security check departments and finally I checked into the airport transfer hotel successfully

I have used both terminals recently and compared to some other airports in Asia and China this is overall a much better airport That being said I dont agree with some of the reviews here and I definitely dont mind to be at this airport This airport can easily be reached by subway And even for a minute ride to the city the cost is only  The waiting area at the gate is spacious with enough seats provided some areas at the new terminal even have massage chairs free of charge You do need to have a Wechat account though to make use of this free service Toilets are clean and you wont have issues finding one Immigration procedure never took me more than  minutes arriving or departing This cannot be said about some other airports in China The other good thing when flying with China Southern Airlines is the quick checkin procedure It never took me more than  minutes So if there are reviews here for long queues at the checkin counters it is most likely due to the lack of staff of that particular airline For instance dont expect a quick checkin when flying with AirAsia The only  minor things of this airport are the security staff and lack of western food options Security staff can be really intimidating rude and superior They dont speak English well and they dont have the need to explain something If they cannot read the specs on your power bank they will confiscate it without explanation They expect you to speak Chinese and not the other way around so much for an international airport However if these are the only cons I wont hesitate making use of this airport

Guangzhou airport is not very big Overall this is a very clean airport and relatively modern There is a clear lack of English signage The shops are not very varied and there are not many food options In short if you transit in the morning dont expect anything European like for your breakfast One thing to add our gate was located in a zone near the smoking area we were travelling with children and had to to wait there for more than an hour with the cigarette smoke

Modelo in the airport is a scam  do not have food or drink there We were charged over Q for one glass of wine and one double Rum The waiter was not overt in providing the price for the wine and charged Q for ONE glass of house white wine I checked and the bottle is a Q bottle of standard wine They also added  tip without consent and when absolutely not deserved  we had to wait about  minutes to get the bill after asking It is daylight robbery
One of the least efficient airports ever Security check is a joke everywhere you have to wait for hours We almost missed our plane as arriving  hours before departure wasnt enough

Small airport with few services Long enough customs procedures and passport control if you land late in the evening when there is little staff on duty However it offers a good free wifi service also available outside the airside

Full body scanner was implemented and opting out for an alternative search is not an option I fully dislike being exposed to technology from which we have no real idea of the consequences especially since I was not aware of these kind of controls taking place

mins WIFI free then you have to buy Wow rd world country indeed Gate waiting chairs  benches are hard as rock Have the seat dividers so you cant lay down Loud Speaker announcements are totally notunderstandable Duty free is delivered on gangway not given to you when you purchase Was impressed to see food venues open early early AM  Selections in Duty Free fairly limited Other mostly touristy knickknack so so

I was interested to read a couple of other reviews of Guatemala airport mentioning that random items had been confiscated at security as this was also my experience and it marred an otherwise positive impression After Xray scanning a guard asked to search my bag and I cooperated fully He pulled out my small nail file and a pair of safety scissors with cm roundended blades and confiscated both items He then added insult to injury by smiling and saying Is OK as he dropped them through the slot Im an experienced traveller and both of the items that were taken had been through numerous other security checks on many previous occasions including in countries with reputations for being especially strict The episode left me and my partner feeling irritated and grumpy as it was so unnecessary I would never have any problem at all with established security rules being enforced but La Aurora should ensure that individual officers arent confiscating peoples belongings on the basis of arbitrary and unfounded personal decisions

This is the only airport where I encountered street vendors positioning themselves outside the terminal building hustling passengers with trinkets and snacks Departure from this airport was far from trouble free There were numerous passport checks along the way at the entrance to the terminal at check in naturally prior to entering the departure hall at passport control naturally at security check and on my way to the departure gate I was stopped by a policeman who demanded to see my passport He ran his fingers over the pages of my passport and then asked how much money I had This unusual request unnerved me so I asked him why he needed to know how much money I had with me He relented and returned the passport to me Then at the departure gate a further passport check and the emptying of all hand luggage for a thorough check including the lining of the case I was glad to leave the airport

I approached a clerk at boarding gate  to confirm my gate number since it was missing from my boarding pass Why it was not noted on my pass is another concern of mine How is anyone supposedly to know where to board The clerk knew which gate I was supposed to go to but when I asked she just kept staring at her screen There were two attendants there but the other was helping another passenger I even waited about  minutes for her to respond I asked her again and she just ignored me My wife then caught up and had to literally tap her screen to get her attention And then with an angry attitude she answered our question All she had to do was politely ask me to wait until she had a moment to help This attitude with staff at this airport is common I am writing this so you can at least try and improve your quality of service The passengers are paying customers we desserv be treated with respect and dignity

Guayaquil airport is one of the best around The building is modern very functional and easy The staff who work there always are profesional and the most important thing is that you always has a feeling of been safe

We took a TAME flight to Baltra Galpagos Checkin was very easy with very short queues and very clear instructions given how to get to your gate For the Galpagos Islands you are required to go through a host of quarantine checks and you are required to pay US per person to receive a certificate Without such a certicate you will be unable to board nor will you be allowed past the passport control at Baltra The airport terminal is very organised and gates are well spaced Great airport Also when arriving in Baltra you are required to pay an additional entry fee of US

Ive flown through this airport several times this year and generally consider it a fairly basic simple nofrills experience Its close to the business areas of Guayaquil and normally transit through migration security etc is quick and painless Not however yesterday  the queue for the exit control and security snaked halfway down the terminal building Even allowing  hours to pass the controls was not enough time to reach my gate before the plane left This is utterly unacceptable the management company needs to get its act together and provide efficient passenger handling

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

This airport is small Very small Arrivals is small and cramped Departures is similarly small and cramped Departures is dominated by a way overpriced duty free shop at one end and at the other is a small eatery In between is a small seating area and toilets I had planned on arriving at the airport a couple of hours before my flight and am glad I didnt because there is literally nothing to do So if you are using this airport my advice is to arrive with just enough time to check in and avoid the duty free shop

I am a resident of Alderney and use Guernsey airport on a regular basis The customer service provided by GS security staff is non existent Every opportunity to make your journey swift and courteous whilst carrying out these very important duties seemed totally irrelevant to the staff on duty today  I was travelling with my mother in law who was in a wheelchair after having surgery The amount of undressing and unpacking of hand baggage was totally unacceptable After extra body searches with an ever increasing queue of people I retrieved our belongings and started to re pack and get dressed Unfortunately my mother in law had left some small liquid bottles in her bag Understandably the items had to be checked I apologised but was met with a stern look and rather than rescanning the bag had it completely emptied and re searched I was not alone This was happening to many others  flights were departing at the same time in an otherwise empty airport There was no urgency or friendliness Someone near me said that they felt very intimidated and like they were in Russia Whilst I have no problem with tight security checks I do have a problem with the lack of customer service This is a consistent problem whilst leaving Guernsey I dread going through every time Why is it such a problem Youre innocent until proven guilty unless travelling through Guernsey airport In my opinion the worst experience of anywhere that I have travelled through I am retired BA cabin crew In this review I put no I wouldnt recommend this airport but thats such a shame because service throughout the Island is fantastic and no way reflects the island of Guernsey

Flown Aurigny to Guernsey four or five times from Gatwick Of course a visitor to Guernsey has no choicethe airline has a monopoly The flights themselves were only an hour and uneventful Aurigny flight team is usually OK Not rude but not terribly friendly either My last trip the Guernsey airport staff was a very bad dream They treated me like a suspected terrorist Im a pastmiddleaged solo female traveler Kept me until the plane was completely boardedI was the last one allowed on board They opened my suitcase and removed every single item They turned my book upside down and flipped the pageslooking for who knows what I fully expected sniffer dogs at some point Since the trip itself had been stressful horrendous weather hotel room robbed this last insult was so upsetting I was finally allowed on the plane but fighting tears The flight attendant was nasty and gave me a look for holding everyone up

What a very unpleasant end to a lovely stay I went to the cafe upstairs asked for a prawn salad we no do them madam but theres a picture of them in the ladies toilet I replied no madam I asked if they did them in the cafe on the other side we no do them here madam but there is a picture we no do salad I did go back into the ladies toilet and took a picture of the advertisement just to convice myself I wasnt going mad I travelled with hand luggage and had been searched on the way out my small deodorant and small tube of E cream were in a plastic bag on show However there was a problem so everything had to come out being of a certain age I didnt give a flying fish who saw all my ladies accoutrements the culprit was a half full or half empty ml of tootpaste so ml but that wasnt enough everything else had to be examined except the ladies things the phone charger had to be taken away and taken to bits for all I know the deodorant etc all had to be scanned again surely if they had all passed first time they didnt need to be reexamined I wasnt bothered as I had plenty of time but it seemed very odd and left rather a sour taste all the little boxes of pearls and jewellery had to be taken out and examined I then had to repack everything which I did quite slowly I can only assume these people have nothing else to do but annoy passengers and being called Madam all the time didnt help Finally on to the other cafe and yes they had salad little plastic tubs of prepacked pasta and stuff not quiite the delicious seafood I had anticipated If I ever visit again Ill make sure my hotel makes me a crabprawn sandwich for the airport because it was all prepacked plastic food

I cannot believe the absolutely ridiculous bag search I have just had to endure The full suitcase was emptied and checked in front of all passengers coming through underwear and all Very upsetting and is the st time out of many bag checked that I felt violated The check was completely unnecessary as I was compliant with all items in my suitcase and removed the items that needed to go through separately This needs to be addressed because it is very upsetting to flying customers who should not be treated like criminals
Lost my phone at Guernsey airport and the security staff on that day pulled out all the stops to get it back for me so grateful a wonder team Everything else ran like clockwork

Had  minutes at Guernsey airport before sending off my better half Went to the upstairs bar for a farewell pint Only  person serving but queue only  deep No urgency clearly and over  minutes later eventually served to be told that there was no beer No effort to rectify the fraught beer supply either Inflated prices inflated waiting times deflated staffing with deflated service

The Airport is really small and the departures lounge is small and unintuitive The weird door thing doesnt do anything as you could board any plane once out there Past security the duty free shop is small and is not a world duty free There is no WHSmith or Starbucks in the terminal Otherwise extremely good service

Guilin airport is not as big as I thought for the number of passengers  the shopping places are limited and I could hardly find a decent cafe here Crowded terminal obviously cannot cope with the number of travelers The goods offered in shops are expensive and water is not provided anywhere as any other airports do

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful

The airport is small clean and convineent however very expensive To fly into or out of this airport makes no sense with the outrageous prices Better prices available from MSY an hours drive away from the west andor MOB an hours drive from the east Note  this information is prior to Hurricane Katrina and may not be accurate at the moment but if and when normal operations resume this information will serve similar to preKatrina GPT

Gwalior airport is very small although a much larger terminal is being built and should be running by  When it fits itll be able to handle up to  aircraft simultaneously currently only  via airbridges Until it fits you have to make do with an antiquated terminal with just one departure lounge with barely sufficient seating no WiFi and then a sorry walk across the tarmac to your waiting aircraft

Through Goiania on a trip from Sao Paolo Small regional airport with surprisingly high number of flights on what appear to be only domestic routes Arrivals experience good walked from plane to terminal and out within  minutes of leaving the plane On departure very straightforward I would recommend not going airside until necessary there are no facilities at all apart from one snack bar insufficient seating and very crowded as in fact the whole place was Easy to find a taxi There are plenty of cashpoints as well but these are outside the terminal on the kerbside road Also a small viewing gallery upstairs

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well

Haikou Airport is not too bad but the toilet facilities are a bit dirty They do not provide toilet paper on the toilets so youll need to get some paper from the paper towel supply next to the toilets Checkin gates dont seem to be crowded at all When I got to security I thought it would take quite long but it had been really fast  minutes to scan my hand luggage After security there is a cafe bar located before you enter onto the terminal Now this is where it gets hectic You simply cannot breathe while youre trying to capture a picture of a plane on the tarmac The people just smoke and smoke and basically you could just see everyone smoking in the bar When I approach the toilets in the waiting hall I see them as third class squat toilets They are so dirty and no one seems to clean them with detergent This is what is hectic for foreigners but I am Chinese so I would understand this The waiting hall showing departures do not have English read on them so you have to understand a bit of Chinese to get through the airport as efficiently as you can

The airport of the provincial capital of Haikou on Hainan Island China Dominated by Hainan Airlines and China Southern Airlines The exterior looked a little dated and the interior looked a little yellow with age though the checkin counters and washrooms certainly were uptodate Custom and security clearance were done smoothly and efficiently The main airport lobby was a little dark but it was certainly buzzing with activities The International Terminal serving Dragonair and Air Macau was tucked into an inconspicuous corner and not properly marked I did not see any signs either in English or Chinese Touts littered the airport exits If you do not mind the haggling RMB should be about right to get you into the city if not go for the Airport Shuttle bus Cost you only RMB and you can grab a taxi from its terminal for only RMB to anywhere within the city itself

Hailaer Dongshan airport traffic is very inconvenient bus frequency is very few usually have to wait for a long time There are only three automatic checkin machines in the whole terminal which is not very good There are few queues in the manual checkin office and the attitude of the staff in the information office is very good Its not good to go through security only  minutes before departure There is no restaurant after the security check The price of the shop is very expensive Its not good Theres free WiFi and its very fast The airport signs are very good The arrival baggage claim area is very narrow and it is very crowded when multiple flights arrive at the same time but the luggage speed is very fast The queuing time of security check is long

A small modern gate airport Smiling and timely checkin security and boarding Pleasant airy shared lounge with good Mongolian and other ethnic items reasonably priced Ours was the only plane at the airport let alone scheduled to fly around midday but all shops and facilities were fully open and staffed Only criticism is the lack of a bar which I would prefer to for example the bridal wear store

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline  a subsidiary of ANA  If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is  yens and it takes only  minutes

The custom officers were mean and condescending He kept shouting whats wrong with people these days and do you even speak English while we were being nothing but polite and patient even after a long international flight

A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

The airport is lovely and everything went smoothly for our arrival from Glasgow Security and customs went quick and luggage transfer was seamless However there needs to be regulations put on businesses on the other side of security that are selling products for outrageous prices The cheapest  bottles of water I could find cost me  They were ml size Everything in this store was ridiculously priced Food items way overpriced Talk about gouging tourists that have little options for items to take on the plane Airports should take responsibility for this happening everywhere We came from Scotland and Ireland and thought it was bad in those airports But here in Canada we witnessed worse

Why does security screening not separate travellers with connections going to USA and huge families travelling on charters Stuck behind hundreds of families and just about miss my flight Easily able to queue travellers not on charters  people for am flights and customs doesnt open til am Very bad planning and execution

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit
This is my second time in Qatar and the eGate is not working properly The immigration lane is frustrating it took  hours just to reach the counter

Leaving the airport is a painful process Waiting times for a taxi is unacceptable while there is a metro line this is not in use  hours How can it be that a prestigious airport like this does not have uber or a  hour metro line

Love this airport but can someone explain the logic of having to throw water away that has just been given on an incoming flight Doesnt make sense
