One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

I had a problem with the immigration I somehow missed the immigration check after my evening flight from Hanoi to Luang Prabang my responsibility of not having checked if I had a stamp The next day I went back and they charged me  on top of what I already paid made me sign a paper written in Laos not a copy or a picture I was able to take after I asked I paid as there were no other option They were not nasty but not kind they kept telling me its my fault for not checking No sharing the responsibility or acknowledged that they might have not done a proper job on their hands So check your stamps before you leave there are  different separate lines to do one for the visa the other for the immigration stamp and be aware that they can play the game they want At the end all is good you pay and you have your passport back with a big smile from their side

Appalling rip off of   posted on notice board then an extra  inexplicably demanded for visa was expected but nevertheless galling Welcome to Laos give us some money for no good reason and if youre Canadian its  Who knows why Taxi drivers are raking in the cash You pay  for a taxi ticket into town Then it turns out you are in a minibus with  other travelers This means the driver is making  for a  minute ride into town Thats a fortune in Laos Appalling

Luang Prabang International is a small and pleasant airport with a decent selection of amenities and relatively good service Upon arrival in Luang Prabang immigration officials will direct you to the relevant desks for passport checks if you dont need a visa you will be directed straight to the passport control desks The airport has a money changer located right outside the arrivalsdepartures area where the US dollar rate is relatively similar to the rates quoted in town There is a desk to order a taxi for  kip per person or if you prefer a cheaper ride you can try to hail a tuktuk from outside the terminal Checkin was very quick on my flight departing Luang Prabang and I cleared the immigration check within  minutes as my SilkAir flight had few passengers Inside the airport there are some shops selling local crafts and duty free outlets though they werent very interesting Anyone whos flying Bangkok Airways will be pleased to not that they have a waiting lounge in this airport There was plenty of seating in the gate areas and boarding of my flight was very efficient All in all this is a good airport to use  if you ever have a chance to use it and if your flight isnt full

Not a good impression on entering Laos through Luang Prabang airport On the flight you are given some forms You queue in the visa on arrival line then you are told you should get another form from a desk in a corner with no information You queue again in the visa on arrival You pay inflated prices in Thai Baht unless you happen to carry dollars Then you queue again in another line with the first form you completed which has same info as second Staff were grumpy Feels very bureaucratic

Arrivals worked well with friendly staff quick bags and an efficient visa on arrival system My flight was lightly loaded but there might be a significant delay with a full flight Departures were a little unusual Check in emigration and security all worked well but the airside facilities are a little unusual The departure lounge is on two levels the lower level has a small cafe with limited food options and two small duty free shops Upstairs there are a number of shops selling tourist gifts plus a large outlet on a third level which has most of the items you find in Luang Prabangs night market but not at the same price When I visited there were no catering facilities in the upper lounge but there was a massage parlour with six passengers all having a foot massage I would have been happy with this small airport whose terminal is a couple of years old but for the fact that some  bags were not loaded on my Vietnam Air flight to Hanoi due to a Technical Problem I dont know whether this was the fault of the airline or the airport

The staff are helpful and the airport is so user friendly I accidently dropped my Aadhaar card somewhere maybe in the flight or the airport without me knowing They found it and gave it to me in the shuttle bus They saved me so much trouble

There is no jet bridge at Lucknow airport so you have walk down the stairs from the aircraft and board a bus Overall the airport is very small so there isnt much walking to do During my return flight I arrived at Lucknow airport  hours before departure standard practice at many US airports I was told to sit in a waiting area and checkin  hours before departure Checkin bags are screened before you visit the checkin counter Once you clear security the boarding area is small with limited seating

Travelled into and out of here on a LCYZRHLUG long weekender last summer and look forward to doing the same again this year Incoming as smooth as expected outgoing return complicated by a fault on the outbound plane  but didnt miss my London connection as a result and the small but civilised departure area think those few Ryanair routes that involve local airports that arent hastily assembled wooden shacks offered a wellstocked duty free shop and a sporadically manned bar Shopsbars available outside the airport for departing passengers and accompanying friends and family  no problem with one final Swiss beer before checking in at short notice All in all a very pleasant experience

Arrived and departed from Lugano Airport last week It surely is one of the smallest airports I have ever seen Passport control is extremely fast baggage reclaim too SWISS does not yet recognize priority labeling from other Star Alliance members Regular shuttle service to and from Lugano city centre is timed to match arrivals and departures from and to Zurich There are a few shops and restaurants outside the airport Checkin on departure is very swift too The staff are highly motivated and efficient They managed to have our luggage checked through to final destination although our onward flight from Zurich was not booked under the same reservation code Yet again no priority labels You then go through security control and are in the waiting area about five minutes after entering the terminal building Only downside there is not much you can do after passing through the security control But then it is only minutes from arriving in the departure area to boarding

Incredibly poor and unsafe customer service In the departure hall at the gates I cannot find hand sanitizer anywhere They have bottles of it standing at each gate but behind glass and only for staff use

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now

We passed through LUN briefly on two occasions in September and found it to be a pleasant small airport with a couple of interesting features The first one was that when disembarking from a domestic flight one is led into the terminal building but the door to the main terminal is always closed so the person leading you has to knock on an adjacent partition wall to get someones attention to come and open the door We thought that was cute The second feature was the presence of a coffeecappuccino wagon in the terminal area dispensing a variety of freshly brewed coffees as well as freshly squeezed orange juice We thought that was a very civilized touch and considering there didnt appear to be any restaurants or cafes available that we could see at least that simple option was appreciated

Considering this is an airport in a poor African country Lusaka Intl Airport isnt that bad The arrival hall is rather small en dark but it is possible to leave the airport only  minutes after landing The immigration officers  Ive only seen female ones  are kind and easy going and I can say the same about the airport staff in general The sanitary provisions are old but clean The departing hall is more modern  from the late s   and there is more space and light Theres one bar and one shop Just be aware of some huge leaks in the roof during rainshowers  at some places miniwaterfalls come into being

Horrible airport Almost no seating available If you want to sit you have to sit at a restaurant and that means youre required to buy overpriced junkfood Airport staff is almost invisible Was traveling with my family but a staggering lack of facilities for baby care I had to do some work on my laptop but there was nowhere to do that The gate was old did not show accurate information and also didnt have enough seats In one word appalling Never using this airport again

I had a bad feeling as we queued for the temporary drop off zone at Luton airport as I had heard horror stories of this airport in the past but I went into the journey with an open mind We flew out with Ryanair and check in was an absolute breeze with no hold ups at all Security was very busy but we had FastTrack purchased and cleared the lanes within a few moments the staff were very friendly and helpful to us as we passed and even were open for a laugh The departures area can feel a little claustrophobic with low ceilings till you reach the main area There is good choice of FB as you pass through with a nice selection of shops to spend some money Seating is decent as well outside the FB areas so there is space to take a load off I spotted a nasty spillage on the floor and spoke to a cleaner who told me she would attend to it straight away The gate are for Ryanair and Wizz was a little cramped down the corridor with limited space but if you time it right you wont be there long Overall a very surprising experience at LTN and one I didnt expect
Giving up on Luton Parking is so ridiculously expensive were picking Gatwick or LHR from now on All good other than that so not much else to say

Luton Airport always used to be a joke and it still is as far as queue management is concerned As you approach Security old young and infirm are forced to walk up and down unnecessarily for miles between taped barriers even when there is hardly anyone waiting to go through Security Staff with ironically Im here to help yellow teeshirts stand aimlessly around and rather than helpfully opening and closing the queuing lanes as demand dictates their job seems limited to shouting at anyone who has the temerity to duck under a barrier even when there is noone in front of them When challenged one of the staff unhelpfully stated if you dont like it you can buy Fast Track ie pay more to avoid walking needlessly backwards and forwards  clearly this is the managements intention to make life difficult for most passengers Awful customer service  come on Luton Airport time to up your game

Arriving on a cold wet after Midnight flight I was delighted to see a shuttle bus to take us to the pick up in the Mid stay car park So we sat on the coach and after about  minutes we moved off Down the road about  yards it stopped at what I assumed were red traffic lights on the main road no that was the end of the journey We then had to haul ourselves and luggage up the hill into the car park This was made worst by the pick up point being located at the far righthand corner What a waste of time Whilst operational difficulties due to the fire are understood the arrangements are very poor

The worst of the London Airports by far I have used this place for some  YEARS now and all its done is take one step back for every step forward They save money at the expense of the traveller by simply putting too few staff on Departure checks and even at am on a late October morning they only had a handful of overworked checkers and MANY empty booths yet a long LONG line of travellers getting more and more anxious as the time frittered away ON top of that they have progressively expanded the ridiculous farce of making every one waste time by being FORCED to go through a serpentine retail experience with no chance of any short cut It may be the easiest for us to get to but in future I will travel the extra miles to Stansted  and I recommend others in East Anglia to do the same A Cheap and NOT Cheerful Airport to use Be warned

I got to the airport two and a half hours before my flight was due and joined a queue to check in as I couldnt do it on line and put baggage in hold after queuing for nearly an hour because there were not enough desks open was told to go to help desk definitely not helpful to pay  each to check in then go back to the first check in and get boarding passes Then had to take luggage to yet another area as it was a large case so yet another queue Then it was on to security and that was another massive queue where nobody new what the other was doing and due to the time we had to spend there the gate for our flight was closed and we were unable to fly When asked for help was told we would have to buy another ticket for a flight that wasnt for another  hours and go through it all again  The staff in every department from security airline help desk and Airport are all agency staff and they dont want to take responsibility for anything Over  on Flights Luggage Parking and Transport to and from Airport and I never got to leave the country I beg anyone reading this do not use Wizz Air or Luton Airport as they are unfriendly unhelpful and unprofessional
This Airport if you can call it an Airport is the worst place i have ever been and it gets worse every time Unorganized crowded expensive filthy no food no service Avoid this place at all cost

The security team at this airport is rude inefficient and unfriendly Youll always have problems You can be totally ok same bags and clothes at other airports yet in Luxembourg they will find something The security staff is rude and speaks with travellers in a non respectful way

Shockingly poor airport Checking border passes on a screen visible to the public security and GDPR breach No border police at border checks until after the queue has stretched well into the duty free and pilots were delayed Eventually one police officer appeared their eGates remained closed

We were very unsatisfied with our transit experience at Luxembourg airport To just change the gate make a transit you need to leave the airport and go through all the security again So if your connection is less than  hour I would think really carefully about choosing Luxembourg airport as a transit Employees are very slow huge unorganized queues everywhere no staff available to ask questions The queue at the security check is especially annoying the plastic bags for liquids are not provided in advance they are given right near the machine which makes the security control xlonger We were very hungry and wanted to have lunch in the boarding area were all the gates and its the first time I see an airport without any restaurants with proper hot food only sandwiches and chips available take it or leave it

Whole airport poorly organised Queues for both check in and security were huge We arrived  hours before our flight and were still in the queue for security  minutes before take off We had to get called forward to skip some of the queue or we would have missed our flight and this was the same for a lot of people Clearly cant hire enough staff however they could hire two men on stilts to dance for a very bored and frustrated crowd Ridiculous Also the only food place when we eventually got through to the gate refused to serve us saying they were closed

Terrible security experience Im a frequent flyer and this is my first bad review ever but I need to share I had a new ziplock l bag bought especially for this trip all my liquids were there The woman then told me its not l even though it clearly was and told me to throw away half of my stuff including medicine ml  and a stick deodorant She didnt listen to me I calmly explained that this is not a liquid and I flew with it in different EU countries with zero problems She arrogantly stated that in Luxembourg it is a liquid but she had no clue what that was  I wish I asked for her credentials Avoid her at any cost she will ruin your experience I want to add that my friend had the exact same bag and products and a different guy had zero complaints about it Plus the airport has no smoking area

Nice design and spacious However thats where the good news stop Security totally outdated and badly organized despite high staff number Outdated scanners no body scanner no scanners for liquids outdated tray management Constant showing of ID needed no automated gates Wifi is crap and almost instantly saturated All in all not the most pleasant experience in fact a bit outdated Shame for a country which wants to be one of progress and innovation

We are currently at the Luxembourg Airport flying with three kids and are not allowed to enter the waiting room for the departure gate as it is too full  although you are able to see that there are still seats left So the kids have no access to seating rest rooms or beverages  food The security  police let certain passengers pass but is denying access to all other passengers No information at all no signs no info no spoken info Nothing

So painful to go through this airport every single thing took long queues and waiting time From the counters to check in and most importantly the border control with few people having to check luggage of hundreds of passengers In summary not a nice experience

Weak and inconsistent security Bells restaurant  cafe no prices on display After persistently asking the manager the shop assistant eventually grudgingly produced the menu prices pic from behind the counter Rude and unhelpful

the main problem is the number of checks and the lack of efficiency with which they are carried out You get checked on entry but staff seem to be able to walk in a side door unchecked At least I could see no sign of any checks being carried out when I looked down the corridor Once upstairs you go through another check once your flight is nearer time Two operators manned the walkthrough door but had to hold people back since many of those already through were standing just inside awaiting their handluggage  a much longer conveyor is needed after the scanner There was one operator manning the screen and also carrying out searches if he saw anything in peoples handluggage While he was doing a search the queue just stood still since no more scans could be conducted I admit the passengers did not help  they seem to think L bottles of water will get through unnoticed Another staff member would speed things up but the longer conveyor is needed My camera bag was searched and  x AA batteries removed I was told Batteries not Allowed These  batteries have been in the case for the last  visits to Luxor Ignored were the batteries in torches spare camera batteries and the battery in my camera When did this change in the rules come about Or did the guard just need batteries for his torch Then you get a handswab then to get into the gate you undergo another handluggage check to make sure laptops pads cameras etc work On the way out I used Edinburgh and London airports  there was only one security check to be negotiated in each Maybe security staff should be sent to other airports abroad to see how it can be done Our plane took off nearly an hour late I have no idea if there was a technical issue or it was late arriving but even if all had been perfect the queue would not have been processed in time anyway so it would have been delayed If Luxor Airport wants to have any reputation other than Its a joke could I suggest that a serious look at security is required before Luxor Airport can consider matching normal international standards

Why is it that the customs officers in the arrivals hall are still targeting older people and lone women travellers and asking them to open their luggage They have even asked people to open wrapped Christmas presents What are they looking for when the bags have been checked at London Heathrow and Gatwick airports with the most sophisticated equipment on the planet The security forces would be better employed guarding the planes due to leave to make sure nothing dangerous is put on board

We flew into and out of Luxor as international passengers Landing at the airport all flights are transferred to the terminal building by bus Once stepping inside the terminal it is possible by get a visa at any of the banks before going to passport control where the visa is check and landing card as previously issued and filled in on the plane is taken Immediately after this there is a staff member who checks your visa has been stamped Never ceases to amaze the level of irrelevant check From here to baggage collection customs and then out to face the scrum of touts They seem to be keener as there are far few flights The return trips was much the same but in reverse Touts scanning checking bag drop exit card given at checking and need filling in before getting to passport control The lounge is quite large with four duty free shops one on each corner and in the centre a gloriously named food court with quite a poor offering of food but expensive To the gate No announcements but numerous displays on screens but very slow security checks As to why with  staff they didnt open a second channel to deal with hit is beyond me Not many people there only three international fights listed for departure that day Previously used the same airport many years ago and it is a vast improvement on what it was One really good thing is the authorities seem to have got rid of the toilet touts so more selling loo roll and trying to extort baksheesh

Arrived at pm for a pm flight Long queue for security just as you walk in the door  before check in I accidentally left more than ml liquids and my laptop in my bag but they didnt detect it in the chaos My wifes belt set off the security metal detector alarm but the security staff were busy looking elsewhere in the chaos and didnt notice Check in lines were another long wait Passport control only had  staff on so another  min wait there My son wasnt visible to the passport control officer but that didnt stop his passport being stamped by an officer clearly in a hurry The policemanofficer who checks that you have a passport stamp before moving to the next stage couldnt find my stamp but the queue was so long he just waved us through not checking any of our  passports There are more duplicated security checks to get to the gates but this was equally lax and might as well not have been there The fellow supposed to be watching the xray screen was talking to his mates We had  minutes to rest at the gate before boarding It looked like a modern airport but in the chaos and queues we didnt get to see it Tip get there early expect chaos and with that in mind you cant be disappointed

The airport building is much better maintained than Cairo with shops and cafe However like Cairo there are very bad touts particularly on the forecourt I havent experienced the ones at check in as others have but this may be because of my flight time Domestic check in is extremely chaotic and disorganised for departures with conflicting information Arrivals international is similarly chaotic for people who have no organised visas in advance with long poorly organised queues for both visas and immigration both with a shortage of workers I recommend international visitors get a visa in advance as this will save a lot of frustration at Luxor as arrival is very disorientating with guides touts and unhelpful staff giving conflicting information Beware the taxi touts outside and be sure to have small denomination notes upon arrival for a bus into town

I would agree with the above comments The only smoking areas are the restaurants where you are obliged to buy at least  beverage and at E for a really rough coffee we felt a bit ripped off They were also charging E for a kids lollypop which would cost p in the UK On check in there was a guy lifting hand luggage onto the Xray machine you had no choice in this then getting stroppy because all I had was a E  the equivalent of  Sterling for  seconds work

Lviv airport modernized for the  Euro football championship is a modern airport with all the european standards of comfort security and ergonomy Staff are very attentive to passengers needs especially at the security and passport checks It seems a bit cold anyway with very large spaces empty of everything and terribly lacks of lounge services such as cafe or bars once you pass the security check especially for the domestic flights Well served by local transport it is very close to the city and even a taxi ride wont be expensive A good point in this airport is that you wont be glued by a patch of taxi drivers upon arrival like in Boryspil or many Ukrainian airports
Once again I used Lviv Airport four times in August  Very satisfied with facilities and staff who work there Definitely beats many USA airport who have a lot to do in order to improve

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either

The staff at this airport were rude unhelpful and uninformed Both security and passport control were extremely slow We arrived  hours mins before departure would have been earlier but the signage to get back to car hire drop off was poorconfusing and still nearly missed our flight Security was a shambles badly laid out with bottlenecks that slowed the process down Passport control was obviously understaffed with just  desks open There was a large queue downstairs to get to an escalator that took you upstairs to the passport control hall where there was another large queue Passengers were being held downstairs to prevent overcrowding upstairs Our gate had already been announced by the time we cleared security so we went straight to the back of this first queue We were still in this first queue when our flight status moved from boarding to closing When we asked the staff holding the queue in place what we should do we were met with shrugs and a what do you want us to do about itwe dont care attitude Worried about missing our flight we found a lift that bypassed the first queue and got up to the passport control hall where one of the desks was being used to fasttrack certain flights We made the flight and had to wait for other held up passengers so the flight was delayed The BA crew were great and apologetic even though the situation was beyond their control It sounded like parr for the course for Lyon Im surprised BA and other airlines put up with such a terrible airport that treats their customers appealingly

This was our first time travelling to Lyon rather than to Geneva and I wouldnt so so again Took over an hour to get through passport control on arrival as only two people checking passports On our return journey home the queue for check in with Easy jet was horrendous and very badly organised We paid to fast track security as the queues were so long and then queued for one and a half hours to get through passport control All the easyjet flights were delayed due to the issues getting through check in  security and passport control including ours Will not book flights to Lyon again based on todays experience

It is a nice and small airport for a poor country The airport itself is not ugly at all but it still needs to get a little bit more modernized After the  renovation the airport looks much more modern than it used to be but still they could work a little bit more on it

On my first trip to the Amazon in  Manaus airport was a nightmare On my second trip the airport had been much upgraded The entire building had been enclosed and was airconditioned many shops some with quality goods

As echoed by many Manchester Airport is a thoroughly depressing travel experience from start to finish Where to start Outdated incredibly tired and in many areas downright filthy Having travelled extensively I can honestly say that it is really the worst of the worst  Staff on the whole especially security personnel are rude unprofessional and at times boarder line aggressive in the manner in which they treat and speak to passengers They bark out their orders adding to the general sense of passenger misery add to that chaotic snaking lines that staff seemingly have limited control over by not using clear and friendly direction and you have in a nutshell MAN T Sadly none of the time spent at this airport is pleasurable nothing makes you as a paying passenger through the airport feel valued or relaxed in any way The waiting areas at gates are cramped dining options are limited  being generally grubby and tired both in their decor food options and overall haphazard appearance often with long queues and miserable staff plus the kicker the toilets throughout are horrendous Surely we can and should do better If similar budget was spent on passenger areas of the terminal as clearly the more preened areas of duty free for example we would be somewhere near acceptable but I guess its all about money extraction rather than passenger experience I always wonder what overseas visitors must think their first impressions must be awful Would I recommend this airport Absolutely not Should higher management be ashamed of its running and maintenance Most definitely

We let Manchester for Melbourne via Dubai The passage from check in bag drop and security was all smooth The infrastructure coped well with the small number of passengers However our experience on the return journey on  was exceptionally poor the worst we had over the period of a  weeks abroad visiting a number of different airports and cities and indeed the worst weve had ever a Manchester The aircraft was an A and on finishing taxing the flight deck informed us that due to the fact that there is no airbridge available at the moment to take such a large plane we were parked at a remote stand and would require bussing to the terminal Welcome to Manchester We were on the upper deck of the aircraft and there were no steps available to reach from the apron prompting internal cramped potentially dangerous disembarkation to the lower deck to the exit stairs to the tarmac When the bus arrived my wife was told extremely rudely by one of your employees to  get on the bus now She explained she was waiting to board with me I was  or  people behind her He repeated his rude remark Welcome to Manchester The bus took us to the terminal but parked in such a way that disembarkation was only possible from the front doors Again more delay On entering the ground floor doors we realised the escalator was broken meaning lugging up luggage to the top of the stairs No help was offered to families with young children buggies or the elderly Welcome to Manchester We then arrived at Immigration What a farce  snaking lines of queueing arrives once you got to the beginning of the snake  The automatic passport readers were malfunctioning so badly the people assisting on the queues had to intervene slowing the lines down even further And so to luggage retrieval Two incoming flights with baggage on the same carousel  trolley fee  minute wait Welcome to Manchester Nowhere in the world compares

Early flight with Easyjet from Belfast to Manchester Smooth experience  then Fast Track through Manchester to Geneva Quite the worst experience we have had in years Five footmark spaces at security with only one allowed to be used Officious unpleasant staff who actually reorganised every single tray before letting them go through the scanner They used SIX trays for my wifes hand luggage and FOUR for mine Bearing in mind that we had just travelled from Belfast with two trays each being used laptops etc this was unbelievable I was told by the agent that I had breached security because I reached across the rollers to get a tray Then the luggage was pulled for inspection At this stage many people were complaining I asked politely to speak to the manager who when he approached me told me to Stand back He was quite the most ineffective manager I have ever encountered  many staff standing around doing absolutely nothing with no supervision Then my cabin bag had to be emptied and the lining unzipped because the scanner had detected something  the handle of the case  an  Montblanc which I have travelled with weekly for the last  years By this time the manager had scampered off somewhere ignoring the chaos All lounges full food offering poor elsewhere Unfortunately not a forgettable experience but one which thankfully I will be able to avoid in the future All in all a shameful offering

Terrible experience Arrived  hours before a short flight to Newquay On arrival we found it very confusing to find T departures after a few wrong turns we got to easyjet check in along with about  others Easyjet had two desks open hence it took us well over an hour to check in Security was chaos the dingy room was packed and staff were screaming out orders like it was a prison camp The xray machine was rejecting every other bag we had to plead with one of the staff to check ours otherwise we would miss our flight we were lucky I met a guy in the throng of people waiting for their bags to be checked who told me he was autistics and was feeling overwhelmed hed already missed his flight and didnt know what to do with no staff interested in helping We had to sprint to the gate only to have to go through more security here my partners passport wouldnt scan and staff again didnt care and were unhelpful We fly to the UK and then on to Newquay or Dublin from Australia regularly this was the first time we have enter via Manchester and will be the last

The airport is on the smaller side which usually means shorter TSA lines especially during nonrush hour times The airport also tends not to be too crowded but can feel a little tight around the Southwest gates due to their large presence at the airport but overall the terminal is not very crowded I have TSAPre check and on my last trip through the airport in October of  it probably took less than  minutes from when they looked at my boarding pass to when I picked my bag off of the screening belt Talk about efficient The parking is also cheap with always plenty of spots available There is also a small rental car location as well which is more than adequate for an airport of its size The terminal and the bathrooms are also kept very clean and Ive never had too much of a problem There is also some restaurant variety past the security checkpoint with there being a Starbucks a sitdown restaurant Burger King Dunkin Donuts Hudson News and a small bakery Overall the regional airport is a nice cheaper option rather than going to the congested Boston Logan airport and is super convenient for anyone living in the Seacoast area The only downfall of the airport is that most flights are going to have to be connecting flights since they only fly to major hub cities and the planes tend to be smaller regional jets so I recommend to bring a very small carry on or just a backpack since it will have to be gate checked when boarding

This was my first time going to Myanmar We landed in Mandalay International Airport An airport clearly built a long time ago awaiting the prosperous times ahead The immigration control took a bit of time since there was an aircraft arriving from China Eastern at the same time as ours Airport staff directed some of us westerners to the Diplomats counter which cut the waiting time at immigration substantially  At the airport the currency exhange rates offered for US and Euro were best at the Farmers Bank

Mandalay International Airport was built at the turn of the st century It serves both domestic and international destinations and is designed like many airports around the world it just works slightly differently somehow Arriving on a domestic flight you are bussed into the single terminal building where you walk passed unmanned Passport Control Desks to one of  baggage carousels before having your baggage hand and hold scanned and into a large Arrivals Hall with the usual selection of booths and a small cafshop selling bottled water There are TV Screens showing which flights are coming or going Marble floors and air conditioned Departures start with the need to scan all you bags hand and hold before going to Checkin Counters which are clearly numbered in  banks A B C and D After this is the a boarding pass check and into the Departure Hall which is upstairs Checkin and arrivals are on the ground floor There is a large selection of shops and a couple of barcafes not all of which are open for domestic flights Security Scanning is done at the gate and Gate  seems to be where all the domestic flights leave from via a pier down to a bus In the Gate area there are no shops or toilet facilities just rows of seats looking out on to the apron and in the distance the runway parallel to the terminal building The airport is larger than the current traffic levels so it does not feel crowded or too busy but it has a new feeling that none of the other airports in Burma Myanmar have

Despite more international flights the terminal still has the feel of a ghost town After a very speedy check through security all domestic passengers are directed to a largish departure area and bussed out to their aircraft The colour coded badges all passengers are required to wear ensure no one gets left behind or attempts to join the wrong aircraft There are more food outlets than my last visit a few years ago sadly the washrooms and the rest of the terminal show no sign of having been properly cleaned since then

After the splendour of Yangon Airport International  not Domestic which hasnt been updated since easily the s Mandalay Airport is reminder of what could have been Coming in to land the airport looks deserted We were brought to the larger looking terminal by bus and instantly I recognised the Japanese design having lived in Japan for several years Aside from the outstanding design nothing else was even close to Japan Most of the lights were off immigration desks looked abandoned and one of the panels of glass separating the baggage and arrival halls was badly smashed Still service is efficient if only because there is no one to serve facilities mostly work and taxis are plentiful If the reforms continue to improve Myanmar this airport could be a real gem If you need to fly to Mandalay  and domestic flights are not as scary as they sound  it will do just fine but lets hope for better days

It seems very under used airport  comparing the facility and the passengers go through here Its all new a couple years old  with very long runway Arriving from CNX on Air Mandalays prop plane seems odd on this runway Its located pretty far out from Mandalay city center The airport seems deserted after all passengers left

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

Never seen such a laid back airport as Mangalore I had a flight to Mumbai at am and I reached the airport by am only to find out the checkin counters are all closed and open at am only There were many passengers like me waiting for checkin After staff for Jet Airways arrived the counters opened and I got my boarding pass again was made to wait for security checking to open The counters of security checking opens only after am  all employees were seen gossiping having their tea and so lethargic And there were so many passengers waiting even passengers with special assistance Never came across such a lethargic airport

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised

Worst airport I have ever visited Less comfortable chairs for the passengers to rest  worst is many are with long hours transit You will see many passengers sleeping on the floor along the walkway to the departure gates Foods are pricy  with limited choices Luxury stores are with less items on display WiFi is not strong enough Internal looks old and a bit run down The airport has to be upgraded to preserve the image  dignity of the country

Worst airport I have ever seen No food selection available only a scarse choice No place to take a seat to eat in terminal  Very old and outdated airport Also arrival was very chaotic Taking a taxi is an adventure Sim card for Internet is at extortionate rate Security do not follow international rules set by Civil Aviation Authority but they have their own rules Be ready to have unexpected issues when going through security I travel the world and can confirm thst Manila Ninoy DAquino is definitely the worst airport in the world

I have never experience such chaotic and overcrowding lines to Terminal  checkin counters of PAL Four lines waiting for our turn to have our luggage xrayed by One machine Average wait is about   hours Then another average  hours in line to checkin luggage And all this waiting is just to checkin on one airline PAL Even at LAX Tom Bradley terminal with more Passengers coming and going is never this chaotic

I fly almost every month abroad for work and sadly always end up in Terminal  of NAIA If youre departing from the terminal theres only  restaurant before the immigration so if you arrive before your check in counter opens sadly you wont even have anywhere else to sit Always crowded and since the checkin counter area is pretty small the lines between airline counters can get confusing esp when the terminal is busy Arriving in the Terminal  however is much worse There are I think  electronic counters open and most of them dont work properly Other than that there are only  manual counters where those who cant pass the ecounters coz they dont work all fall in line at There is an electronic checkin supervisor booth beside the ecounters but they dont even assist the passengers who have a hard time passing through And dont get me started on baggage claim Itll take you  mins  hr to get your luggage

Manila is a very crowded and busy airport I have been through here a number of times Its sad that in this day and age you have to lug your bags to a bus to get a connecting flight to Terminal  Still I guess it is what it is Bus was crowded and very hot I guess this was to be expected as this was a very busy time when I was traveling Signage has improved a lot since my last visit I was able to find my way to my gate very quickly Always crowded here I feel that they could perhaps improve the air conditioning a little Aside from that little to complain about

Manila Airport should be avoided at any cost Last three times I have been there Airport lounges are fully booked and can not accommodate passengers Dirty unorganized ridiculous cues at immigration There are no smoking zones at the airport and if youre a smoker better avoid this airport and Manila itself Food will be served with plastic cutlery so you can imagine cutting a piece of meat Philippines has been such an awesome place warming welcoming affordable and reasonably priced foreigner and tourist friendly Unfortunately not any more Next time I am flying via Singapore irrespective of cost Simply avoid Manila at any cost if you care about your dignity and you value your money Thank you

Eventually helpful staff but they are all transfixed on to mobile phones constantly so fairly hard to get their attention Departure area is an uncomfortable chaotic hot very old area with absolutely nowhere to buy water or a coffee whilst waiting for your counter to open I had to stand for  hrs with no water as my previous domestic flight to Manila arrived  hrs before the next Be careful when transferring from one Terminal to the next very tricky and a lot of scammers everywhere There is WiFi in the airport but it is the slowest WiFi on earth All in all not a good experience at all

This is one of the worst airports I have experienced and in stark contrast to the wonderful people of Mozambique and their gracious hospitality I used this airport  times this month My arrival experience almost turned into a catastrophe the immigration is so disorganised that it is not funny they are all over the place and no one seems to have any idea what they are doing They first had some issue with printing out my visa which took almost  minutes to sort then they pasted by visa on the passport of another person and handed it to me I took it and walked a few steps and realised that this is not my passport and returned to the counter at which stage there was a frantic search to find my passport then the immigration officials removed my visa which was pasted on the other gentlemans passport tearing the page in his passport and then proceeded to stick it in my passport which was finally found lying buried under other papers at the immigration officers table The worst part is the constant demands for money by the officials at Maputo Airport at departure After a few days I returned to Maputo for a domestic flight and the policemen outside the airport stop tourist cars and ask for drink money the same thing at security check and this happened again as I was heading for my flight out of Mozambique Thankfully by now I had learned how to play dumb On the domestic side this airport is small and there is not much there to write about and on the international side its a bit bigger and there are a couple of shopping outlets but hardly any plugs to charge your phones or laptops but the infrastructure is still manageable but the harassment by officials who should be doing their jobs is just insane

Having visited over  airports worldwide Ive heard tales of corrupt security practices but my recent experience at Maputo International Airport has left me genuinely shaken The entire process felt intrusive and intimidating leaving a lasting negative impression My taxi was stopped at the airport entrance and police officers searched through my belongings While I understand the countrys ongoing conflict with rebels this level of scrutiny seemed excessive After passing through the initial security check I had to wait for a green light from the police before proceeding to checkin The checkin area was minuscule serving only a handful of airlines The air conditioning was barely adequate and the overall ambience felt cramped and uncomfortable A few souvenir shops and snack bars lined the waiting area along with two VIP lounges The real ordeal began after checking in As I ascended a staircase two security officials approached me in a forceful manner demanding to know how much cash I was carrying and if I had any local currency or USD I explained that I primarily used digital payments and only had around  in cash for purchasing a snack Despite my explanation they insisted that Brazilians are wealthy and should have more money They proceeded to rummage through my bags scrutinizing my belongings with an aggressive attitude I remained calm throughout the ordeal reiterating that I only had the clothes on my back and some cosmetics Their search yielded nothing and they eventually gave up appearing visibly frustrated This unsettling experience left me feeling deeply intimidated I noticed that the security officials worked in groups making it clear that travelers should never attempt to pass through security alone The entire encounter left a sour taste in my mouth and I sincerely hope to never return to Mozambique

Maputo airport is very close to the city centre It consists of two vast glass buildings domestic  international totally of proportion to the small numberof flightspassengers However checkin area was quite busy security was rapid and airside was bright and airy A few souvenir and dutyfree shops and a number of airline lounges most of which were closed Airbridges looked tired and rusty

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying  so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived  hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost  hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded  although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as  hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

One nice feature of Maputo Airport is that it has one of the few remaining exterior viewing terraces so you can stand outside and take in arrivals and departures A worse airport on arrival than on departure with the slow waiting around for visas on arrival be sure to have exact change if you can and the relatively slow delivery of baggage which may or may not have items missing or delayed if your transit was via JNB

A pretty basic airport but seems to function fine At customs people needing visas need to line up in the visas line  if you line up anywhere else youll just be told to go to the visa line Its a bit confusing as the booth is slightly behind the others Visas are US cash there are no change facilities so be prepared They take your money and passport and then walk over to an office near the baggage claim where the visas are processed Everyone has to stand around and wait in front of the office until an immigration official walks out with a stack of passports and starts calling out names at which point they will give you back your passport with the visa inside In the meantime you can collect your bags the carousel is literally  metres away Plenty of taxis right out the front you cant miss them Barclays ATM also just outside so easy to get local currency Outbound the checkin is pretty straightforward though I would suggest getting there a bit early as it looks like it would get mad in a rush Public toilets on the second floor a little bit away from the action but nice and clean Not much past customs other than the ubiquitous bar but nice to have one last Laurentina premium before leaving
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

Maracaibo city is the hottest city in Venezuela and so is its airport  degrees or more it would appear that the air conditioner system is not working at all This airport itself and its staff is another story compared to Caracas Intl I spent  hours in Maracaibos airport and I found nothing but rude and careless staff all around the airport My flight to Miami was delayed apparently for some problems with the jet bridges that at least I did not have the chance to see or walk through to get to the airplane The prices are extremely high in restaurants and stores I just cant understand why Maracaibo being such an important economic centre in Venezuela since it is the heartland of the oil has such a dull and unfriendly airport

The worst airport experience ever Security check after security check Police is performing racial profiling selecting anyone travelling from a non EU countries and taking fingerprints Signs in the airport are extremely confusing Check in personnel are lazy chatting among themselves rather than working No fast food in the waiting lounges just some extremely dry sandwiches

The Cleaning ladies in all toilets at the airport remove the toilet paper from the cabins and if you ask for paper they ask for a charge I think its really mean and it should not be like this Toilet paper should be provided for free

Our experience at Marrakech Mnara Airport was an absolute nightmare The checkin process was a complete disaster primarily due to an apparent shortage of baggage handlers This caused a massive backlog resulting in an unreasonably long line that moved at a snails pace Passengers were left stranded and stressed with no clear communication or guidance from airport staff It felt as though no one was in charge and the lack of organization was appalling What should have been a straightforward process turned into an ordeal that left us scrambling to make our flight For an airport that serves as a gateway to such a vibrant and beautiful city the management here is a glaring disappointment If youre traveling through Marrakech prepare for frustration and delays Truly one of the worst airport experiences Ive ever had

I arrived at Maun on a flight from Cape Town Maun airport is a relatively simple and small airport with almost no conveniences and no air conditioning We had to walk from the plane to the entrance of the airport although the distance was short Just before entering the door we were stopped and asked where we were coming from and several passengers had to produce their Yellow Fever vaccination records No one had given us immigration forms on the plane and thus we had to complete these in the small hot area just before the immigration desks At the time I was there only one officer was processing passports so there was some delay However the lady immigration officer was pleasant and processed me promptly From there I went to the baggage claim area and while there used the restroom it was not pleasant I collected my baggage without much ado and simply walked past the customs inspector who ignored me and was then in the main terminal area A few steps past that and I was at the desk of Mack Air the airline I was to use to fly to my safari lodge The Mack Air people processed me promptly and the next stop was a luggage scan before entering the preboarding holding area The security folks used a scanner but also insisted on opening my small bag and having a looksee My feeling is that the scanner is not really very good The preboarding area is simply a nonairconditioned room hot and without much in the way of creature comforts Although Mack Air gave me a bottle of water I could see no facilities for purchasing drinks or anything else My impression is that Maun Airport though an international airport is dated and seriously needs some upgrading At the time I arrived another flight was arriving and it appeared that this was the time of day when almost everything happens at the airport Still it is stretched to capacity and seriously needs some upgrade as it handles most of the transiting traffic between international carriers and the smaller shuttle airlines such as Mack Air that move passengers to and from the various safari lodges in the Okavango Delta Thus whether one recommends Maun Airport or not it is a necessity if one is going to the Delta and its only plus is the friendliness of its staff

Unfortunately this airport turned into a real nightmare over the last couple of years The good thing first They are still able to attract airlines to open direct routes to various places so you could technically save some time avoiding a stopover at a hub They offer free german newspapers for everyone Public WiFi is a bit slow but straight forward and actually quite ok Very close to a highway so it can be easily reached by car The bad things Public Transport is probably one of the worst in the world The connection to the train station is not meeting the demands and only runs at limited times The transfer to Munich is done by a single operator with a very unreliable schedule expect to depart Memmingen within  minutes of the scheduled departure time the operator always waits for all booked passengers to arrive as theres no regular service and instead of expanding the service to accommodate delayed passengers they just wait without any information Why to blame the airport operator Because they must be aware of it and they always have the chance to break the monopoly and allow a competitor as an alternative But my guess is that the airport wants to focus solely on non aviation revenue and they dislike people who dont bring their own car The terminal is way too small to handle the amount of passengers I dont know why the airport hasnt been facilitated by the german flight plan coordination office due to its limited capacity Obviously the management isnt really proaviation or into the seamless travel concept of the international aviation business Due to the amount of PAX handled at peak times the terminal quickly turns into a dump yard cleanliness is for sure a big issue here The airport doesnt even try to create a pleasant experience for the customers the whole process is chaotic and I can recommend to arrive earlier than you would do at big airports like Munich or Vienna as it consumes a lot of time to struggle through the mess Hotel availability is also very limited they should focus on attracting some competitors a proper Hilton or Accor branded hotel would be a blessing also with the highway next door as Memmingen is a little village and hospitality isnt their business Secondary airports always surprise when they come up with a night curfew they prefer cancelling flights over waking up some cows or donkeys its in the middle of nowhere there arent many people living in the vicinity Luckily it never happened to me as I avoid flights around the curfew but sometimes you see passengers from the day before around the airport still waiting for their last days flight Staff is ok but I think they have a lot of stress and need more patience and training its seems like most of the people do the job only to avoid unemployment benefits not because they are good at what they do To sum it up If you can pay the  extra and choose a full service airport like Munich or Zurich with outstanding reliability and comfort If you need a quick connection to a more remote place Memmingen is an unavoidable option

You know an airport has major problems when the number of welcome assistants exceeds the number of check in staff If I am going to hell when I die Mykonos airport reminded me what I can expect The new private owners give every indication of wanting to milk the profits without considering passengers at all It was completely unclear where to queue to check in and I wasted time where you hand your bag over and had to queue again Several people made the same mistake Departures horrible No spare seats  minute queue just to get a cold drink No vending machines

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around  minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as  flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee  sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

This place doesnt even deserve to be called an airport Nothing Ive recognised from  years of air travel is present here Certainly nothing thats made travelling easier Its total chaos Badly designed and totally disorganised From arriving to boarding the flight I was stood in any of four different queues for two hours Checking in on advance saves no time You have to queue out of the airport at a desk which has no sign so you just hope its the right one People push in constantly After an hour of that once youve it a tag for your bag you have to queue again to deposit your bag because the scanner is before the check in desk conveyors Then queue again for passport Then stand in a packed gate area in another queue until you board We got in a bus that left us near the wrong plane and had to walk across the Tarmac Stressful chaotic tiring and a massive time waster

The worst airport we have ever been to its an absolute shambles from the minute you walk through the door both coming and going There is no organisation You queue to check in then queue in an even bigger queue to drop your bag then another queue for security There are no computer screens so you have no idea about your flight times etc or delays No air conditioning The toilets are disgusting no tissue never been cleaned by looks of it Not a nice experience which is a shame as Mykonos itself is absolutely stunning but the airport would put us off coming back

Avoid this airport if you can When arriving at Mykonos airport the st August in the peak of the holiday season  flights were leaving at the same time and only  check in desks were open It took  hours to check in one luggage No effort has been made to speed up the process There was not a single information screen or announcement to tell about delays and no staff was visible The checkedin bags security is made manually by the passenger and you need to go through the other queues Its very messy and disorganized The departure lounge is small and very crowded Our flight was delayed  hours simply to allow private jets to land and our plane was not supplied with water The service provided by the airport is unacceptable Mykonos has been a popular destination for decades but their airport is beyond any acceptable standards

So upon the approach of my gate for my first departure  minutes after boarding time none of the flight details in the entire airport had been updated to inform me that my flight was delayed This is Spirit Airlines that Im referring to My flight had been delayed over  hours due to the lack of crew I know this is a small
airport but it is not hard to update your information in the airport the terminal the gate or online in order to inform your passengers before potentially going through security On top of all of the inconvenient change of plans the lady at my gate attempting to inform us of all that changed was quite possibly the most incoherent person I spoke to on my  day stay here in South Carolina I will never connect here or fly Spirit again The only bit of accommodations or considerations I received was a free upgrade to vacant exit row seats I didnt receive a voucher for breakfast no help trying to find another airline that could get me there sooner or a voucher for a future flight for satisfaction Had it not have been for the pilots coaxing all of us passengers and explaining what she apparently was incapable of there would have been an outrage in Gate A

We were delayed for  nights due to bad weather on the th and th January  The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled  times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

Noise announcements My flights had been delayed today Its now more than  hours that Im still waiting Im right now at the airport gate  Not sure if ill get my flight But my disappointment is for the amount of repeated announcements Ive been counting its less than  seconds between announcements and they repeat over and over the same message This must be the most noise airport Ive ever been and Ive been to big ones I love Fiji islands This has nothing to do with the numbers of repeated announcements they do

International layover  international transit queue was slower than customs Security check required but never left secure zone of the airport Had a lady behind me have her sealed duty free purchases taken She purchased from her last location and was given no opportunity to access her checked bags Based upon experience and other reviews Its a nice airport friendly staff with absurd and antiquated policies blindly followed by staff Do not recommend

Staff are friendly facilities clean but was quite annoyed that when I deboarded and went through the transit area security checkpoint  bottles of perfume I bought in the departure terminal of LAX immediately prior to the flight to Fiji were confiscated and destroyed because they were just over mls even after I showed them the receipt proving I had just bought them in LAX The most annoying part apart from wasting my money and no longer having a gift to bring back to my daughter was that immediately after you leave this transit lounge security checkpoint you proceed straight into a shop that sells bottles of perfume that are over mls meaning that you will need to take those bottles in your carryon back for your next flight anyway so what is the point of destroying my bottles Not impressed Airport security team needs to be sat down to explain how they justify such an absurd policy

Airport itself is fine Simple Easy to get around and not too large There is a Tapoo shop and Burger King checkin side Once through security there is a couple more eating places and  bigger duty free shops as well as a WHSmith There is a very weird rule that you have to carry your Toiletries in a ziplock bag for checkin This is OK except they want to charge you for one It seems a very pointless rule for rules sake But then after youve gone through the gate things get strange Water and stuff youve bought in the departure lounge also has to be under the ml or in a duty free bag They check all your bags and so I had a small bottle of unopened water just for the flight and had to throw it The shops should tell you this or everything should be put in a dutyfree bag tho thats a bit useless for water Its a weird rule and completely pointless since no other countries do it It ruins all the rest of the experience if the airport The staff also cant tell you why they are doing it

Nadi airport was very busy when we arrived We had to use steps to exit the plane and then walk a way Three international flights landed so immigration was very crowded Many people with children and elderly having to line up for some time It was very slow Some passengers must have had issues as some were with agents for a long time Shame these are not dealt with separately Bags were already there by the time we got through Then we headed towards car rental to get our SIM card F card saw our whole trip through digicel Departing was ok Note there are only two options to eat landslde but far more airside Also if you buy water airside they will bag it so it is ready as you board the flight as your bags get searched before boarding

Nadi is a fine airport in some ways and an airport in need of even more significant improvements in other ways After flying in and out twice Im glad to see this small airport mostly modernized at least the lobby and checkin areas and looking very beautiful This is a reflection of the success of Fijis tourism industry and the welcoming face that Fiji wants to portray for tourists Checkin was not a challenge at all Going through customs and immigration leaving the airport briefly then going back through security pregate were no problem The signage to shuttle buses taxis and public buses could still stand to be improved but the airport was so small that I found where I was going A bus pass can be bought for  Fijian dollars and a bus can be taken into central Nadi for less than  USD Connecting to your next flight should be no issue as like I said going through customs is no problem as long as you dont have anything significant to declare Now there are some cons First of all theres only one gift shop thingy I can remember postsecurity and their prices are as high or higher on some products than youd pay in the USA Australia or New Zealand They have a monopoly Second staff in said gift shop dont seem to care if you fall over dead as long as they get their money as thats obvious in their attitudes Third security personnel have this stupid policy where they check carryon bags AT the gate as planes are being boarded without warning They dont want any unauthorized liquids to be brought on which means that even your carryonfriendly toiletries better be in Ziploc bags thankfully mine were and theyll confiscate your  drink bottle that you bought in that unfriendly gift shop for security reasons Yeah I echo the sentiments of some other travelers who have posted in saying Thats stupid Fourth their WiFi ranges from pathetic to nonexisting In all Id far rather fly into and out of Nadi than a lot of major hub airports in the USA but for an otherwise very welcoming Fijian people and culture this airport doesnt have a lot of the Bula spirit

The custom security was ridiculous Traps everywhere Started with the custom security who was asking for the little zip bag for small items where we only had a lipstick The security was very nice to advise the bag cost  cents from the shop next to the checkpoint When we went there to buy we were told there was a minimum spend of  Walked around the shop nothing is  Then we bought the cheapest item of  plus the  cents plus  transaction fee ended up spending almost  No other countrys security actually have this kind of requirement Fiji is the place for tourism to be shaved by the locals Be careful

Arriving into Nadi airport was no problem at all however departing was quite ridiculous with the rules they have in place and procedures Before checking in we were stopped by a security agent at her post who wanted to see our passports and ask us some TSA questions which is fine However she asked if I had an itinerary for the both of us which I had luckily printed but didnt expect for it to be needed at that time as all you usually need to check in to any airport is a passport and she wasnt even a check in agent So that was a hassle and waste of time Check in process was fine once we were done with the security agent However going through security screening was annoying They had pulled me aside for a small hand sanitiser I had in my bag and a roll on Ive travelled through so many airports where it is okay to have these items not in a bag as well as a lip balm But these guys just seemed bored and wanted to make it a big deal Luckily there was a little toiletry bag attached to my suitcase that they put it in but it was very unnecessary and wasted my time Ive also read that they wont let you take duty free products through from another country even if its in those security bags provided in other countries This is the only airport I know that does this and it is ridiculous This is the worst airport I have travelled through

Absolute worst experience with the customs officer I had arrived from Sharjah with Air Arabia and customs wanted to check the baggage of each and every passenger Slowed the exit process Even though the signage says green channel and red channel they force all passengers to go through the red channel by checking all the bags and questioning them on any electronic device I was moving to India for good and by law Im allowed to carry my personal effects They made pay for my  year old camera and  year old gimball The person from the bank who is supposed to validate the receipt wasnt there on duty and came almost an hour late Despite complaining to the customs department no serious action was taken I will never fly into NAG and will never recommend anyone else to fly into NAG Unprofessional staff who rob you in broad daylight

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

Its really shame how the facilities are at this airport Authorities seriously need to look into certain issues if this is to be called an international airport A There was no snacks or refreshment counter in waiting area open past  which is extremely inconvenient as there are some flights scheduled past  hrs PVK Bar is open though B The waiting area was not clean and it looked as if the maintenance guys left sweeping work halfway through Air conditioning was not working properly it seems C Lighting is extremely dull D Its good to use TV screens for entertainment purpose but at least a few can show flight updates as well
