I visited Nagpur City in August  I flew from Sharjah to Nagpur The experience of Nagpur Airport is one of the worst I have had The staff are unprofessional Customs officials present at the airport are the worst they will check each and every passenger their way of checking is to treat you as if you are a thief or a prisoner Second worst thing is the luggage belt it took one and half hours for my luggage to arrive on the belt I advise everyone to avoid this airport as much as possible

Nagpur is the worst and most inconvenient airport I have ever visited The luggage xray at the entrance is still followed which has stopped almost in most of the airports Even after we got our boarding passes for the flight we had to wait for  min for another security check in This is inconvenient to the passengers who had to stand and Wait for so long There was no genuine reason for the delay The security was filled with staff and sitting talking and reading news papers Id rather prefer traveling by train than use this airport Extremely disappointed Where other cities are developing so fast when it comes to roads airports etc Nagpur has a long fight to win to even get to a decent place You are also using tags for the cabin bag security which is ancient and had been curtailed in other airports

Nagpur is the largest city in central India and the second capital on Maharashtra Nagpur Airport Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport is a small airport located km from the city centre The airport is very small in size and also in the amount of destination it serves so it is difficult to judge Given its capacity it can handle max up to  aircrafts at a time and anything more than that there will be congestion and the flight will be delayed The airport is clean and the staff can be rude at times

A truly awful airport to fly from in so many way We had to pass through  stages of security starting outside the airport which was so cursory it was meaningless Then we had to go through  fullon get undressed security stations one within yards of actually boarding I wouldnt mind if it made you feel safer but it didnt There was zero signage to find the Premium Plaza lounge that BA use and staff sent us in  different directions All in all a depressing way to end a great holiday

I am a Business Traveller and have Sky Priority The Sky Priority queues in Nairobi are never monitored and are always a freeforall Why cant there be staff to man the queue The chaos causes delays every time When you speak to staff they ignore you I dread going through Nairobi Boarding the plane Sky Priority is ignored Everyone gets up and you have to push your way through as a Business Class passenger

Always the same Coming off a long haul flight and transiting through JKIA Even as a business class traveller the queue for the transit security check takes at least an hour Total chaos reigns Only two gates are open Security staff totally overwhelmed This is by far the worst airport to transit through

Due to a late arrival of our international flight we needed to stay overnight in Nairobi Though we had a great stay at the hotel it was really short because all took so long at the airport after landing It was confusing and messy As I was traveling as a mum alone with  young children it always a challenge in itself so late at night Landed around pm if not mistaken My childrens boarding pass was printed but not mine so staff took my original boarding pass and went to print it so I ended up totally at the back of the queue Despite asking I was not allowed to shift back forward with the children I showed them my Tz residence permit while I was in the queue so I was told I didnt need to fill in a form But  minutes after completing the immigration check I was called back to fill a form anyway Immigration officer was very insensitive by  yet again  asking out loud and in front of my children  are these your children  When I commented that he should be more sensitive with this question in front of the children he refused to stamp our passports Then he went to watch some videomovie on his phone We waited really long both in the immigration queue as well as downstairs WiFi was not working there had also been no WiFi in the plane so had not been able to notify anyone Nobody of the staff provided much information We were  dumped  in another queue downstairs not knowing what was meant to happen We waited a really long time for the hotel pick up with no info Six weeks ago we also passed through Nairobi airport and both going and return we a small group of passengers got lost in transit up and down stairs It took a while to figure out where go Both building and staff are the most disappointing I have ever encountered in any of my trips Will do whatever possible to avoid this airport in the future Kenya What a missed chance to shine

Very expensive compared to any other airports that I have used Facilities are very basic The inflight information board does not update making it difficult The announcement is also done in a local accent that is not clear

This airport is a complete disaster it looks like an abandoned warehouse there no information center to ssk for any informations no one knows what there doing because everyone I did ask about the information they didnt know anything Staff are just busy on their chats for example at Gate  for TRANSIT INFO DESK No one was there for a good  hours Im like what are they being paid for if they cant be present for assisting passengers I cant express enough bad the experience was and how on earth the Toilets dont have water Really are you guys out of your minds Im so sorry for those who have to use this Airport as their main point for traveling Theres no restaurant or cafes for passengers or lounges and it is by far the worst airport you can go to

This is a small airport in a small exclave of Azebaijan It looks neat and clean especially from the outside Very few tourists arrive here Arrival and immigration was smooth A curious thing about this airport is that on departure you first need to go through immigration first There was only one immigration officer on duty Checkin was slightly chaotic with local passengers breaking the queue There are no proper duty free shops inside The only shop selling local products was staffed by a single bored assistant There is not much to do in this airport

This typical Thai regional airport is surprisingly busy Perhaps also due to the presence of the Chevron offshore helicopter base There are about  flights a day tofrom Bangkok Facilities are limited so its not an airport to linger in That said the land side restaurant upstairs has a nice view of the apron so you can have a beer until you see your plane landing before going through to the departure lounge where seating is limited The car park is always crowded which is due to people using it as a park n ride when they fly to Bangkok it being free of charge

Terminal  of Nanchang Changbei airport is horrible and a complete embarrassment to Nanchang and China It is supposed to be international but Ive seen small town bus stations in a better condition They seem to be forever renovating the international terminal meaning that when passengers arrive to checkin they must stay in a waiting area that is tiny and becomes very cramped Furthermore there is no heating or AC in this part of the airport so you feel uncomfortably cold or hot depending on the weather Checkin desks only open  hours before and once you clear immigration there isnt even a restaurant just a shop that sells limited confectionery and duty free products Finally you can never get a taxi at the international terminal If youre lucky a tout might appear but you will get ripped off or you can walk across the car park to the domestic terminal and if youre luckier still you might get a metered taxi but they are reluctant to use the meter Overall a pathetic excuse for an airport and I always dread flying out of here as travelling from Nanchang Airport especially the international terminal is an ordeal

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal  had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Worst airport Security control took away  hard cheeses claiming food cannot exceed g a piece Also took away a climbing carabiner that Ive traveled  countries with Never seen such ridiculous rules implemented in the rudest way possible by the staff there For a flight within the EU Apart from that airport is very old fashioned and not very clean

Feels old and outdated Outside is chaotic confusing on a first visit Inside feels cramped and old lighting all artificial barely any outside light entering in the areas before security No matter its not meant for you to stay anyway there are barely anywhere seat The waiting area is really small with low ceiling that would need a good cleaning Finally some natural light but not a view still Only thing to see out the window is the large bridges with people disembarking A place to go through not to be enjoyed
Worst airport we have ever been to Little seating chaotic security for domestic flights and not even a cafe open Go via another route if you can

Judging by the other reviews here I am not alone in my disappointment In addition to everything others have mentioned I will add that I was flying with a well traveled backpack on which I had a cm long section of bike chain attached to it impossible to take off without a chain tool or to cut the pack itself Not even enough to put my fist through It was used to pick up the pack and secure a lock to Ive traveled far and wide with this chain on the pack  even to the USA where Homeland Security is notorious for its scrutiny of such things Well at Nantes at the security checkpoint they considered this small piece of bike chain to be able to be used as a weapon They said I either needed to check the bag EUR or cut it off As the pack is not worth EUR I told them to cut it off  after giving them an honest if not perhaps sarcastic comment on how they operate their airport After more than  years coming through this airport to vacation in and around the surrounding areas I am calling it quits I will go elsewhere as all of my experiences over the years have added up to enough negativity that I no longer wish to spend my hard earned money in this region Farewell

We had thought of a walking holiday but we got one free courtesy of this airport After walking a long way to the departure portal at the far end of the building we had to walk another long way on the ground floor up stairs and back along the same but reverse route to get to security The officers there were anything but friendly and it was obvious that they escalated their searches and arrogance if one responded with anything other than utter compliance Not a smile or a please or thank you in sight They all wore identity badges but would not allow me to inspect these Utterly the worst goodbye I have ever had from anywhere After more walking we were directed down to the waiting area on the ground floor which just happened to be adjacent to where we left our hold baggage The signage is abysmal amazing us that anyone got on the correct flight Then more walking across the hardstanding and up yet more stairs to board the aircraft Both my wife and I are over  years old and were completely exhausted by this preflight activity We were so looking forward to using this airport  but found it abysmal soulless even hostile

An embarrassingly poor airport The largest in Western France and a choice of six sandwiches and a couple of cakes from a buffet bar The bread was frozen and the sandwiches were disgusting Nothing else apart from a small duty free shop barely larger than a Proxi With trains on strike gilets jaunes blocking roads and this standard of service this is a country that knows how to take the mickey As I am in the hospitality industry I reassure myself that this is the quality of the competition in France

The worst experience ever Very poorly organized and very poor quality Lack of staff and lot of waiting If you transfer remember that you have to go out and do the security check again which takes ages Security are very grumpy and unfriendly If anyone is planning to carry on a skateboard forget about it Mine got confiscated due to the airport rules even if I havent had any problem anywhere with this and I have been traveling with my skateboard for last  years Avoid this airport

It is so poorly organized that even if you tried to design a more inefficient system you wouldnt surpass them Not to mention the staff constantly chatting with each other and treating you like a burden Being an Italian myself I feel ashamed about this airport

Despite booking special assistant for a severely disabled  years old lady there was no assistance available unless we had to wait two hours in which we wouldve missed out on the flight We travelled with British Airways but the service provided is by Naples airport management which is absolutely ridiculous Disgusting I would avoid coming here at any cost if you are disabled

Lives up to its name  no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins  of flight delayed and no aircon  but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Please ever fly out or in to this airport It is the absolute poorly run least efficient and incompetent out of all Ive been to There are only  buses running for all of the gates Our flight was severely delayed and will miss our connecting flight

We were travelling through Oslo on the way to Manchester We had our  year old son with us who is autistic We had fast track access to security as SAS Plus customers Our son was wearing a sunflower screening with the girl pointing him towards the full body scanner She stated that this was a random search At this point he had a total meltdown which is something that autistic children have He did not have any concept of what a random search is The girl who was at the scanner smiled but gave the impression of being totally disinterested and again pointed him in the direction of the full body scanner Following with my son having a total meltdown screaming and shouting two supervisors appeared and swabbed my son However by now the fact that he was in this agitated state was a distraction to others and would have certainly affected the ability of employees to carry out security checks I believe this led to the security lane being closed This situation could have been easily avoided had the girl on security taken notice of the lanyard and taken my son and myself to one side and explained the situation or as is acceptable used some discretion or offered alternative methods of screening As such it must be questioned the level of training as regards hidden disabilities and autism that the security staff at Oslo airport have and their understanding of issues caused by going through security for autistic children as ACI EUROPE guidance Assisting Passengers with NonVisible Disabilities outlines Lastly it should be noted that in all of our travels through numerous airports in Europe and the USA this is the only time that my son has been treated without compassion for his hidden disability has not been addressed Hopefully someone from Oslo Airport will take note of this and implement changes to training and protocols

No smokers lounge in the entite airport is a serious strain on my nerves Im off to a  hour flight and having to be there  hours previous makes it almost unbearable

The most expensive departure from any country weve ever been to Forgetting the  fee just to leave the country the food prices after security are outrageous All pretty much fast food but we found one deli style place  a bagel pizza slice  packets of crisps and  small waters came to  I know airports are expensive but thats more than anywhere in Europe

Landed at San Jos airport at pm from ATL as scheduled but we had to wait  minutes for our gate to open Once I finally got off the plane and inside the airport it was difficult finding the way to the parking garage because the signs are confusing It took longer than expected to get out of the parking garage For a small airport this place is packed The good thing is weatherrelated flight delays are rare which is what makes me prefer this airport over SFO

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

This was the worst experience trying to board the flight The ticket agent didnt understand or speak English She was saying no  over and over She was trying to tell us to get at the end of the line because we were in the wrong zone Then they made us throw away our belongings even though the Cleveland airport had no problems with the same bags I will never use this airport again

Took over an hour to get through security  Quality of food abysmal Terminal was changed several times for no reason forcing us to run across the airport then when we finally arrived at the last relocation over an hour early there were no seats left forcing us to stand or sit on the floor For the WiFi they try to get you to fill out a full survey with contact information Also to make everything somehow even worse there isnt any sort of usable map available online simply states food for restaurant locations Good thing this place is a monopoly because otherwise theyd go under in a week

I was flying out of Puerto Rico through American Airlines and I must say this is the worst airport when it comes to customer service I ask an American airline employee for help as I was trying to check my bag and she was extremely rude she told me no I dont speak English I then asked her in Spanish and she got irritated and told me no I dont think so Once I got to the counter the guy that check my bag was extremely rude with an attitude  Ive traveled through plenty of airports and this airport is cleaner than others airports Ive been to Its not a lot of good variety of food

San Juan airports water fountains are disgusting They are dirty and many are nonworking When they do work the water tastes like it came from a sewer Since you have to dump liquids at security your only choice is to buy bottles of water Two  oz bottles of Dasani are  That is obscene Decent airports have water available in drinking fountains and refill stations for free In addition to the obscene cost it is an environmental issue We carry refillable Yeti bottles but the water is unfit for consumption This opinion about the water quality is from a  year infantry US Marine who has drunk some pretty disgusting water Clean potable water is a basic function like toilets

Small and easy to navigate airport but immigration customs is rude and not friendly at all I had a question in refence to the permit how to fill it out And they were rude because I didnt have a full physical address to my grandmothers house She passed away  yrs ago and they kept insisting to call and get the address
Easy to use airport with less than  flights a day Very short distances easy to handle A god alternative to Biarritz if you need to fly in this area

Met an unaccompanied minor arriving on an Iberia flight The aircraft taxied right to the windows of the cafelounge we could see her escorted as the first passenger off the plane We were allowed into baggage area to meet her baggage arrived within  minutes two minutes later we were in the car Sending her back was just as good No queue at Iberia checkin we could escort her into the gate area she was taken on as first passenger aboard Cannot fault this airport

Better than I had expected but you wont forget that Yemen is a developing country Small terminal but ample staff at Customs and Immigration Both were friendly and professional and lines not out of control in either direction The airport checkin staff seem to work for all airlines as there are not that many flights per day They were also very friendly even though passengers could be a bit of a handful common in this part of world Porters fairly aggressive but will lay off without hard feelings if you say no Dont wait for airport to buy souvenirs everything is very expensive and theres not much there anyway The business lounge is clean and spacious and has a few drinks but not much else I would trust to eat or drink Main seating area not very comfortable

Sanaa International was the worst airport I had the pleasure to be Chaotic exit and entrance airport employees trying to take our luggage and immediately asking in a rude way for outrageous tips almost no information in English unimaginable toilets no information concerning flight departures gate airline boarding time We had to be attentive to the call of an airport employee for boarding in Arabic of course And not forgetting the beauracratic procedures even if they are not as bad as in other countries In the whole a great lack of organization In compensation yes people are friendly as everywhere in Yemen

Not too bad at all actually Id heard before arriving that it was chaotic but I found the opposite Having flown here twice JuneSeptember  and December  I can say that the immigration and customs staff were all very friendly both times all very interested in what I thought of Yemen and why I was here I imagine it is somewhat different if your documents are not in order though The checkin lounge is a bit weird Friends and relatives cant officially enter the building with you as you have to go through a baggage search before checking in However my friends managed to bribe the officials with money and qat and came inside to say goodbye Once you get past the initial chaos at the front door everything is quick and easyor at least it is if youre foreign Being white means you check in first which is an abominable system After checkin you run the gauntlet of immigration The officers are polite and friendly particularly if you speak Arabic or try and within minutes I found myself in the departure lounge which to be honest was quite attractive with ornamental Yemeni stained glass windows decorating the walls A souvenir shop sold overpriced gifts but had an amazing collection of Yemen picture books There was a cafe serving proper coffee if youre a coffee addict and youve just spent months drinking the Yemeni version of coffee youll know what I mean and it was all calm and organised  until the flight was called and pandemonium broke loose Queueing is not a Yemeni national sport and boarding cards were checked on a basis of who shouts the loudest and who pushes the hardest Bonus points are given to those who sneak round the side leaping acrobatically over the barrier it seems Sanaa International Airport is very Yemeni That is meant as a compliment Everyone is very friendly and helpful and there are quirky features like the no qat chewing signs and airport staff having lengthy chats over the intercom system

Santander airport feels like it needs to modernise It is a small airport that is dealing with a larger number of passengers Everything feels a bit worn it could do with sprucing things up a bit The cafe before check in was very nice and had a good selection of food at a reasonable price

Quite a small modern airport which is only  minutes by taxi from the centre of Santander Extremely limited facilities ie one small cafe  bar and one small shop with a very limited choice No facilities airside not even a toilet Insufficient seats airside

Despite being a resident in Chile travelling business class there are long waits to exit and enter the country I often wonder when dealing with the airport staff and border guards why anyone would want to come here ever again Rude unprofessional and utterly incompetent the border guards create long queues for which there is no apology or sympathy for those that have to wait You then get barked at by rude PDI border guards who cannot muster even a smile or mildly empathetic attitude why they need to scrutinise foreigners leaving the country is beyond me

Absolute nightmare of an airport No pharmacy past passport control No soft seating anywhere not even many seats in general Im in the middle of a  hr flight from southern Chile to Australia with a bad back No showers unless you pay USD I love this country but hands down one of the worst airports in the world The USD million upgrade is a joke Only people happy to help are inside California pizza kitchen

Cant understand how LATAM sell tickets with connection of  hour  minutes if just to leave the first national terminal takes  minutes by walking without waiting in the lines Just walking for  minutes if you are in a hurry and need to go for the next flight There are almost no signs in airport if you want to make connections Inside of the airport on the ground floor which is for arrivals  dont know why all few signs from one terminal to another for transfer providing you to incorrect floor you dont know how to reach another floor with departures and need to ask someone of the staff The Staff is very unprofessional I was lost and had  minutes for the next flight and went to the staff of LATAM the guy was watching my boarding pass and trying to understand how to help me when I just asked where is the zone of boarding and then he told me that Im late for my flight and boarding is closed The best thing is that when I was in the gate in  minutes there was the sign BOARDING but it was not boarding yet Really the worst airport

Very poor performance Two immigration kiosks operating after pm for  international flights Waiting times for immigration were    hours No effort made by airport staff to secure more officials at a very busy time

Terminal  International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

Santiago has opened a new terminal and this was my first time to use it I found it to be large and the walk from the airbridge to immigration very long  especially after a long flight Immigration was a rapid process following which there was a form to complete and then one proceeded to baggage claim All of this went smoothly However the ride that I had booked from the airport to my hotel failed to show at the place I was advised to wait and at the appointed time While looking for my car and driver who never showed I was beset upon by a host of persons displaying what they called government issued IDs offering me transportation assistance This proved to be nothing but a rip off and it is my strongest advice that persons arriving in Santiago avoid these people I highly recommend booking a ride in advance and obtaining contact details in case you have difficulty meeting up with the driver and be sure your phone is on roaming mode so that you can call your ride if needed I repeat avoid people offering any assistance and displaying alleged official badges or IDs They will swarm upon you as you leave the terminal They can be very persistent It is a racket and leaves a bad taste for Santiagos airport in ones mouth

The design of this airport makes almost no sense I only came on and off domestic flights in Chile well beside my entry flightbut I am talking about  legs domestically Its the arrival that is the problem For example for domestic flights in the US you come out of your gate and even if you have checked baggage you can proceed directly to your next gate or go to baggage claim Yes depending on where the gate is or in the rare situation that you have to proceed to another terminal it could take a while but I have never walked more than  mins ever in any US airport You come off of your domestic flight and whether you are connecting or not everyone is funneled out into a separate hall and during my domestic arrivals the walk to baggage was at least  mins and I am a spry  yo guyjust glad I only had my computer bag and not a carry on roller I cant imagine the difficulty the elderly or handicapped have to go through to get to their connecting gate or even just to baggage claim And on one of my arrivals I still had to wait another  mins to see any bags from our flight coming out on the carousel

One of the worst experiences at an airport ever First of all the airport doesnt serve alcohol and wont allow you to purchase any for drinking at duty free Next they had a bunch of extra security checks and even dumped all our water at a check right before boarding The flight also left late Overall it was unfriendly and rude and made us feel like middle school students getting punished for nothing eg filling our water bottles to have hydration on the flight Weve been through multiple airports in Chile and theyve all been great experiences  this is not a Chile issue Its a Santiago airport issue Really upsetting and wont be traveling through here again if we can help it

Why is there no pharmacy in this airport I have come from a long flight from Australia and during the flight I started feeling bad the tipics flue symptoms you can imagine been on a plane for  hours sweating but cold muscular sore running nose and the only hope I had was to buy some pills at the airport As all the developed countries and not developed too to calm those symptoms and due the long layover ahead hrs nothing could go wrong As I landed I ask to one of the airport employees where is a pharmacy nearby and surprisingly she told me that there is no pharmacies on the transit passenger area So I ask can I go out a buy one on the pharmacies at the airport outside the international passenger transit area and then come back and the answer was a NO Apparently if you are traveling trough Santiago Airport and for some reasons you forget your pills and you get sick the only solutions is suffering Plus there is just  places where they are allowed to sell beer knowing that the airport is massive imagine been walking around and nobody knows where you can get a really nice coldie

Very small airport which should simplify arrivals but disastrous transportation options to reach the city Taxi service is limited we had to wait in line for  minutes to get one There is no Uber option and limited information on bus services if you do not want to wait for a taxi forever

I was on the first flight of the day out of Santiago de Cuba airport We were told to be at the airport  hours before departure However staff didnt even turn up until  minutes after this time and by the time they were ready for checkin it had been a  minute wait Then another wait ensured as we had to wait for security to get ready This other wait was another hour in the checkin hall with minimal seating and no one anywhere near the security area Once finally getting into the departure gate the seating which was abundant in here was set up like a maze The shop was unmanned and the food was stale Only praise I could give was cold beer and great wifi speeds

Avoid transiting through this airport The transit desk appears to keep banking hours and you will be forced to collect bags pay for a trolley and clear immigration You cant go back through security If your flight is more than  hours away even If you have a lounge pass You bought duty free Too bad Airline staff seem uninformed Airport staff are either uninformed or lie pretty sure they lied based on repeated experience with the same staff member to make sure you leave the secure zone Generally treated with an I dont care not my problem attitude from airportcustoms employees

I have been using the Las Americas Airport for more than  years and over recent years with much more trepidation On my last departure the Friday before Christmas I arrived before pm for a flight to Madrid leaving at pm travelling business class After clearing security it took more than  minutes to get through the immigration people and at  I was called to go to the departure gate where I was escorted to the downstairs baggage area because I was told they wished to search my bag which was not locked I could see my suitcase but no one wanted to sit down so I waited for more than  minutes and there I witnessed young security men opening cases and throwing items all over the table and floor They opened Christmas presents of people flying to Europe they opened cigarette packets and emptied the cigarettes on the table they opened baby food and destroyed much and laughed in the faces of the passengers Finally I saw a terminal worker from my airline and asked her to try to get someone to inspect my case A customs official came and found only clothes and wanted to know why my case needed to be inspected when it had gone through the xray machines as had all the other cases I was the last person to board my flight and the flight attendants all told me of their dread of Santo Domingo airport try to avoid it

Drove here from Casa De Campo with some buddies returning from a golf trip Myself and a friend walked through security holding our money in our hands We were then questioned in a side room where they laid down the money on a table that was completely broken A young security guard then took  from us and told us we were OK to proceed Also there was about  people trying to fill out the customs card and the pens didnt work Staff didnt care We then had lunch as was told were not able to leave a tip on a credit card Cash only tips they said Felt very unsafe and abused by staff here I hope I never have to go back Place is a joke

SDQ has become a nightmare for Dominican residents leaving Now you need much more time as you are sent from one person to another to have the residency card photographed and then another person to have your ID checked and finally another person to stamp the passport Worse for people who are paying the penalty charge for staying longer than a month Once through the lounges are basic in the extreme duty free items except some alcohol more expensive than the Santo Domingo stores and the process of loading passengers on board chaotic it used to be so good but no longer

Our Easyjet flight to Manchester due to depart  was delayed almost  hours Although other delayed flights were advised on the airport screens ours was not I presume that delays are communicated to airports as other delayed planes including Easyjet were advised Airport staff did not know Check in staff who may have known did not advise SO we spent  hours we didnt need to in a crowded airport Catering was fine and not too overpriced Duty Free used to be cheap but not anymore I have flown out of Santorini  times The time before it was dirty with blocked toilets and rubbish everywhere Now it is a better building but not a better experience The time before that I was allowed to leave the departure gate to spend my Drachmas on a final couple of cans of beer Returning the officer had left so i walked around the metal detector to avoid setting it off I love Greece Not so much Greek airports

Appalling treatment of passengers rude staff and very few staff to ask for help Poor communication around boarding and checkin information We queued for over  Mins to be told we were too early for checking in despite the board initially advising that we could go to the desk We did meet one friendly staff member who tried to help us with bus information which unfortunately was completely wrong Airport is not equipped to deal with the volume of passengers

Very poor service Apparently all the shiny clean coffee machines are finished Both in the main departure hall and past Passport control If you dont want to provide facilities dont pretend If your staff are just hoping for a quick getaway after the flight has left get better staff

rd world conditions Departures involve a stampede for a standing place on a bus which takes you  yards to a plane you could have easily walked to No boarding by row or zone We expected better on an island like Santorini Arrival is similar you take a  yard bus ride from the plane to a long set of steps which you climb only go down another set of steps  seconds later Police at the airport were actually very good and act more like airport information officers than law enforcement Its the only way in if youre flying Just dont have any high expectations

Frankly in shock after going through this airport  times better to ferry to Athens instead and take a flight from there Airport authorities screaming at passengers to get on the plane pulling people out of line to charge them arbitrary amounts for additional baggage fees that has happened at no other airport with the same airline and then denying that the fees were paid and demanding money again People were sitting next to the bathroom on the floor in the stairwell crammed into the upstairs patio because there are no chairs anywhere else The bathrooms had no toilet paper or soap This was really really horrible

This tiny airport cannot cope with the number of visitors that come to the island For our departure all standing room in the terminal upstairs  downstairs was taken up with people also sitting on the floors and stairs A roving customer service person was diligently telling people to delete pictures of the crowds and then checking that they had I was told it was so American tourists dont see it on social media A new terminal is being built but is only scheduled to open in  Though the island is beautiful and we enjoyed our stay perhaps wait till then if you dont want to suffer

Worst international arrival Ive experience at an airport Upon arrival there was no currency exchange and no where to buy a sim card At every other international airport Ive been to I can go to the currency exchange to buy local currency and then use this currency to buy a local sim card so I can use my phone to hail an UberTaxiDidi but not at Sanya airport There was no AC so it was hot and sweaty as well To grab the bus into town you have to walk half a kilometer to the domestic terminal The free wifi required that I be sent a text message first to authenticate However with no sim card I was unable to authenticate and use the free wifi in the first place

Sanya International Flights Terminal Flight got delayed and had to wait at the airport with no aircon and fan Very warm during hot season No other food except for KFC which does not serve precooked food Have to wait for at least  minutes for food to be cooked Souvenir shops are closed and they are only open when nearing flight timing It is like a deserted airport with no proper facilities Only toilets are airconditioned

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab  km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe  yuan   But what I really love is the waiting area outside

Get off the plane and walk to the arrivals hall  no skybridge and no buses It was only a five minute walk but even so the luggage was already on the belt If it wasnt for the greeters from hotels and other drivers the arrival hall would be empty No information stand no sign boards no telephone but there IS a bus to downtown Sanya Being such a popular holiday resort and proud threetime host of the Miss World Competition I had expected at least half decent toilets at the airport Far from it and to be avoided No paper no soap but a smell that can guide you from any corner of the arrival hall During peak season such as May Holiday they have probably  people leaving within one hour But there are less than  trollys Many flights are after PM check out time in mot hotels is noon Many tourists spend the last three or four hours at the airport So the few trollys are quickly snapped up and kept for hours by those arriving early and leaving late On the other hand its really only a short way from the car to the checkin counter The waiting area is definitely too small for this peaktravel season both before and after security check Best to arrive no more than  min before departure and get straight on the plane The selection of productssouveniers sold at the airport is meagre compared to anywhere else in Sanya  and more expensive By the way the beach is so good

Time passes and Congonhas remains the same with the same old problems The most irritating matter is the constant changes on assigned gates which may require you to cross the entire airport unnecessarily youll see flocks of passengers doing the same since changing the gate originally assigned seems to be a standard procedure at this airport There is no subway station Theres a local bus connecting to the nearest subway station but its not a proper vehicle for passengers with luggage Queue for a cab usually took more than  hour but its taking less time on recent days since many passengers are using Uber Everything except the boarding gates area look old and filthy The smell of sewage in some toilets is so strong that passengers can feel it at the terminal hall  this is particularly true at the toilets close to Starbucks Food and drinks theres a good number of options but prices at least x higher than youll find elsewhere Expect lines everywhere WIFI no wifi unless you pay for it I recommend you dont because its slow and unstable

Compared to GRU and other SAmerican airports it is not that bad For arrivals the metro does not exactly reach the airport but there is a city bus that can get you to the nearest station English signage is totally lacking so finding that bus is not going to be easy for international travellers Airport is crowded but for Brazil amazingly somewhat efficient For departures dont even bother to check the gate number on your boarding pass It will change  often more than once before boarding But there is a modestly overpriced barstall after checkin where you can watch the monitor as your gate changes
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

Have some mixed feelings about this airport I enjoy its atmosphere and the boarding area from where the runway and planes can be seen On the other hand many of the usual Brazilian airport inefficiencies are present  high prices constant gate changes no English announcements in boarding facilities and a chaotic luggage claim area

This is an interesting airport for Domestic flights throughout Brazil Check in area is full of lines for all different airlines and like old style the airline offices are opposite to check in Many people buy tickets same day at the airport Not many people speak English but if you ask someone if they do they will try or get someone who does if they do not I checked in for my flight on GOL and had  hours They would have put me on the earlier flight if there was seats available even with the departure leaving in  minutes Prior to security the main building has a round waiting area with shops food areas and so forth If you go to the second floor you will find an Internet cafe barber pharmacy police etc Go to the third floor for a wonderful outdoor bar and a full service restaurant full of TVs and a wonderful buffet You can stay as long as you like and be away from the throngs of folks travelling especially on weekends Past security is the new terminal that is huge and if your gate is at the end it will literally take you between  to  mins to get there No moving walkways There are snack bars and little shops along with plenty of seating NOW You need to understand that there are several gate changes and the ONLY main screen is after security So be sure of your gate if you can Anouncements were made in Portuguese and then English every time People will help you if you dont speak Portuguese just ask Signage is also in English but if you are going out to get a taxi or bus you must take the elevator if you want to keep using your free trolley Taxi line can be long and if you are going outside the city to say the International airport they will charge you  additional to the fare Thats the law Take one of the buses if you can to transfer to Guarulhos

Sign posting is an absolute nightmare Half of terminal  is separated from the other no way to get to the other side unless theyre nice enough to let you through some little bottleneck boarding pass scanner In our case they werent We were made to go outside of the secure area reenter through security screening circumnavigate the whole of terminal  just to end up back right where we started With the exception of being on the right side of some plexiglass Took us  minutes to accomplish this Just to get to the spot we were literally looking at through a window Not even  feet away This journey gives you no sense of confidence in others advice because you are following signs exclusively for terminal  At the end of your trek across the whole airport you finally see signage for terminal  A couple minutes later youve arrived at your gate

Airport help and customer services are bad No actual details or information about things that I tried to ask No real service and I am stuck here since the airport service screw ups Employees dont speak anything else than Portuguese or if you are lucky Spanish I speak only English all the information available are as squared as an circle It is nice to wait unknowingly how many more hours I need to sacrifice from my holiday I hope that these problems are not daily Ive been here at least time before and had problems then as well

Organizational mess Interactive signs show wrong info or not info at all Voice information are only in Portuguese and gate service does not speak English Near gate   buses stay all the time near the doors running inserting its fumes constantly inside the terminal Ecology

The new terminal  is finally a leap to the st century egates for brazilians make the process stressless and quick food and drinks limited but good options margaritaville starbucks pizza hut subway etc They take all cards but very expensive though Air con is really strong I would bring a sweater if I were you staff are ok but only speak portuguese foreigners be aware They have installed electric outlets everywhere very nice even in european airports you struggle to find it Overall good experience The new metro does not arrive at airport you have to take a bus to the terminal it is a waiste of time take the direct bus instead much quicker and convenient

Its a small modern airport with a really nice look On arrival there were some  people arriving from Lisbon So lines for immigration and visa counters looked really long at first However it took only  minutes to clear immigration and collect baggage As there is only one or less international flights per day there is no bank at the airport and the ATM wasnt working You can still pay with euros for taxis if needed and there is an official list of taxi fares posted close to one of entrances On departure for domestic flights everything worked well There are some small shops and a caf with normal prices in the main hall There was nothing opened on departure hall as you enter it only before flight departure They probably open the small cafe for international departures The strangest thing was that there was no security control at all before domestic departures I have no idea if its usual or not but many locals were surprised Its easygoing life on the islands but it seemed too chilled for me

Being in this airport was so much fun From the royce chocolate factory to different shopping areas there are lots of thing to do I arrived  hours early but still did not have enoungh time to explore the airport The immigration was systemized and there were almost no lines Although it is not a  star airport I think it has to be one of the best in the world

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy  Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every  minutes JR train connections  minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

The queuing time was fast But free wifi was poor rather it didnt work at all Not suitable for work The screen shows departure flights by gate each screen shows only the departure flights from the nearest gate For example if your flight departs from gate A and you are at gate F you will not find your flight on the screen near you So you have to run around to every gate in hope that the screen on those gates will show your flight

A modern and convenient airport in Hokkaido Island There is a direct train service from the Sapporo train station to the basement of the New Chitose Airport station The only negative point about the airport is there are too many shops selling the same local stuff

This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it

A small airport yet convenient for the amount of flights they receive Checkin is mostly fast and efficient yet you cant use any online checkin yet due to restrictions by law The airport has  jetbridges and  gates the  others are used for walk or bus boarding Border control is friendly and efficient The airport has  duty free store but not much other facilities Beware of taxi drivers demanding outrages prices for a trip to the city center  KM should be more than enough Theres a bus service to the city center but timings are a bit off

Sarajevo Airport is very small and very manageable After you enter the main building there are check ins Afterwards you have to go to the first floor where is one departure hall with  or  departure gates There is plenty of seating they also have big beanbags for seating which can be quite fun and relaxing There is only one bar with snacks and one shop If you are travelling with children the signs for baby changing room is misleading  after you follow the signs there is no baby room You have to follow the signs for the bathroom for disabled If you wait for a long time you might get very bored
Small airport small queue size fast passport processing airport  Staff are reasonable but not a single smile Smoking is unrestricted Taxi service available outside gate

Very small but clean and cozy airport with only  gates Going through the passport control and customs was a breeze I do agree with the previous comments about taxis There is no public transportation from the airport to the city so unless someone is picking you up or youre picking up a rental youre forced to take a cab which will routinely rip you off and not even turn on the meter For a  minute ride I was charged  marks currently USD  If you can arrange some type of transportation other than the taxi my advice is to do so

Small very clean and efficient from security check through checkin immigration and baggage claim But its not really a hospitable place theres no restaurant only three cafes offering the same things little or no food a very modest and unappealing dutyfree shop and a newsstand selling only locallanguage press If you have to spend time here youre out of luck Dont take the airport taxis which all overcharge instead call the official city cabs by dialling  they arrive quickly and charge the relatively low official rate

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

I have arrived and departed SJJ several times in the first half of  and find very little to criticise  It is fairly small and not very busy so checkin luggage handling passport checks etc tend to work quickly and effectively I have only encountered helpful and friendly staff in all areas One criticism is that there is no public transport to the airport except taxis  and you should agree the price before you get in I did once walk from the nearest tram stop probably about km not recommended even with only hand luggage particularly when it starts to pour with rain halfway

It is very clean and the toilets are cleaned by the crew literally every  minutes I was stranded in this airport for more than  hours due to fog which Sarajevo suffers during the winter months of December to February It is funny kind of similar to the rest of Sarajevo in regards to hospitality They are either very friendly with a big smile or just very rude and disinterested For example the people at currency exchange information desk baggage claim and check in just couldnt stop smiling But the people at the security and ticket counters were rude Ticket counter agents any request such as air fare inquiry schedules etc creates extra stress for them that they make you feel guilty for being a human being For instance the lady at the Croatia Airlines ticket counter all I wanted was the air fare from Sarajevo to Munich and she rudely yells at me and say we do not sell tickets from Sarajevo which doesnt make any sense to me whatsoever

Shirdi is a small regional airport with about  movements per day Located about km south west of Shirdi there is nothing outside the airport other than two ATMs and very little inside The only commercial outlets are two small kiosks selling some food and drinks This is not an airport to kill time in easily unless you bring your own entertainment There is just one gate no lounges and the seating in the departure lounge is not really sufficient at peak periods The air con works well and free wifi is provided without any need for vouchers codes etc although it is quite slow Also for some reason the terminal wasnt built next to the apron meaning you have to bus to and from the aircraft

Very modern lots of space etc Luggage arrived from aircraft quickly Still the very antiquated way of processing visas ie  windows  queues to suffer fortunately we were at the front then queue up again for immigration The really bad bit about this airport is its distance from Siem Reap itself nearly kms  usd by car and nearly an hours drive A nice new road leading from the airport that then connects to the bumpy ramshackle main road for the rest of the journey For most tourists the old airport was far more convenient by a big margin

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

Both arrivals and departures in the new airport are very good The arrivals visa control is very aggressive and unfriendly The passport control is far too slow Departures is good but far from friendly I have an airport lounges pass but was told sorry we havent signed an agreement yet So you have to pay  USD each The water dispensers only give hot and warm water why no cold water

A lovely small airport once enter the departure area left hand side is check in counter straight went to immigration counter have your luggage security check and holding room and board Only one small dining place found in this area and right hand side is arrival area with toilet in the middle Once inside the gate hold room the airport free WiFi is not signal well Currently the only commercial flight using this airport is Fireflys service to SZB airport A more easy and faster way to the KL city area

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

We left Skiathos on Friday  June after a reasonable arrival at the airport and a wonderful holiday It was exceptionally hot with temperatures reaching  C So queue to check in despite having printed boarding cards beforehand then another queue to drop off the hold luggage then another huge queue outside in the baking sun with the queue snaking around the building to go through security only a couple of scanners available and passport control Once airside all seats were occupied with many passengers sitting on the floor You guessed it  long queue for the toilet longer queue for refreshments Absolutely horrendous experience which will deter me from ever visiting this beautiful island again No point in trying to beat the crowds by arriving early as access to the departure lounge will be refused as it becomes so crowded

benches for arrivals at the terminal People sit on the ground and I understand them You should be ashamed or why do it when you have comfortable chairs in offices What do you care that there are people with small children

As has been noted Skavsta Airport is really Nykoping airport under another name but as long as you factor in the  minute bus ride into central Stockholm it is a viable alternative for getting to the Swedish capital As these peripheral airports go it isnt that bad On arrival the bags arrive fairly quickly and it was a short walk to the bus These run frequently and apparently wait for the incoming flights which is important of you are scheduled to arrive late Three buses an hour leave Stockholms central bus station for the journey back to Skavsta Returning to the airport checkin is a bit of a slapdash affair There are a number of checkin machines which print boarding passes and baggage tags for both Ryanair and Wizzair flights However if you have luggage you have to join the bag drop queue which is just about as long as the conventional chaeckin queue Most of the machines were unservicable when we arrived anyway There is catering both landside and airside Remember that this is Sweden  prices are very steep There is a small duty free shop and well thats about it really There are five gates two of which require passing through passport control and are used by flights to the UK There is nothing the other side apart from a few chairs so you are probably better waiting to go to your gate for as long as you are comfortable in doing so Overall it might not win any awards but it does the job

Pyongyang airport in North Korea is small and almost empty with very few flights and few passengers It is to easy find the guides you need for your visit in North Korea You dont have to look for them they wait for you and find you after the passport visa and customs control The document check and the customs control are surprisingly smooth and fast It takes about  minutes to pass the airport building including the controls The officials are friendly or at least not unfriendly as you might expect in this extremely closed communist country You have to deposit your mobile phone at the customs control but it can be kept by the guides during your visit and you get it back when you leave the country

Sunshine Coast Airport MCY services mainly flights to Sydney SYD and Melbourne MEL with some services to Adelaide ADL and seasonal international services to Auckland AKL New Zealand A new low cost airline will soon be operating from the airport which will make flights north to several cities in Queensland and other flights to Melbourne and regional New South Wales and regional Victoria The airport terminal is located in Marcoola about  mins north of Maroochydore Private Airport transfer services Taxis Ubers and public buses service the airport however the public bus system does not run a timetable that would service all arrivals or departures Paid short term and long term parking is available with some of the long term parking having sails to provide limited protection from the elements There is also an offsite private parking business within the airport precinct that offers secure indoor and outdoor paid parking The terminal has Checkin counter areas for airlines at the northern end and a covered breezeway then leads to security screening and the departure area at the southern end of the terminal The luggage carousels for arriving passengers luggage are also located at the southern end of the terminal along with rental car counters toilets Luggage sometimes can take a while to arrive on the carousels as it appears the incoming aircraft is unloaded and the bags for the departing flight are then loaded before the arriving flight luggage is finally brought into the terminal and loaded onto the baggage carousel The departure area has food outlets that sell food and drinks at the usual airport prices as well as a few shops including a surf shop and a news agency books newspapers etc The northern end of the departure lounge also operates as the international departure and arrival area when the seasonal Auckland flights are operating at other times it forms part of the domestic departure area Gates serve both as Arrival and departure gates and their are currently no aerobridges so you will walk down stairs onto the tarmac and into the terminal Facilities are available for disabled passengers who cannot utilise the stairs The airport at times can be very busy especially if flights are delayed otherwise their is plenty of seating As most flights are coming from Sydney and Melbourne weather or other delays can have a knock on effect causing delays to outbound flights The real advantage of using this airport is avoiding around a hr  min trip to Brisbane Airport on a good day when there are no traffic delays or accidents on the M to Brisbane Airport The airport is expanding and the terminal facilities will improve as part of the expansion project Overall a very good airport experience

Decided to fly via Kinmen to mainland China instead of HKG This required using Taipeis older Songshan Airport instead of Taoyuan Airport Access to the airport is very quick and easy using the Taipei Metro direct to the front of the airport something that Taoyuan is yet to get I used the Domestic Terminal which is odd in many ways as the domestic arrangements in Taiwan do not follow an international standard For a start there is a KG limit despite the airlines website saying KG was okay the error was simply a copy and paste from the airline international sister airline and followed international rules The CheckIn counter were arranged in small islands however after getting your boarding pass you then had to go to another counter along the airside wall for your baggage While the queue was almost nonexistent why it can not be done at the same counter at the same time defies logic Baggage tags simply state the name of your destination in English and Chinese no bar codes and no straight forward ability for transferring to other flights Due to the limited space on the airside gates passengers are asked to wait in the CheckIn Hall where there are amble lounges and Eleven convenience store When your flight number appears above the Security Door you can then proceed through to your gate Flights are very frequent and regular so this was not a great issue and waiting by the gate or the lounge makes little difference Overall it was efficient and quick despite its quirky nature On my return flight the baggage hall housed two belts and the bags appeared quickly enough and I was through and on the metro back into Taipei in little time

Departing on am flight to Kerman All bags Xrayd before you enter the terminal There was one queue for my flight and only one person checking everyone in but she was fantastically efficient and once at the head of the queue the process must have taken only  seconds Amazingly people behind me were thrusting their tickets at her whilst she was dealing with me Airside departure lounge was full and despite a lot of seats very few free There seemed to be about  flight leaving at the same time as mine The lounge reminded me of a s bus depot Plenty of shops around to get souvenirs and snacks although I didnt use them It is a small affair and all gates are in the one area Toilets were grim with long queues Go before you arrive Flight information screens toggled between English and farsi but the English version stayed on screen about  of the time It seemed I was the only European person there Suddenly the screen above the departure door flashed up for my flight Bus to the plane for an on time departure On the return journey bus journey back to the terminal and baggage re claim was very fast I was out of the airport within  minutes of landing Some taxi offices in the arrivals building Overall Mehrabad is a place to catch a domestic flight no more no less A long delay would be a nightmare here The transfer to the international airport is about an hour through heavy Tehran traffic
